body.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚政府否认了将澳大利亚的人道主义接收人数削减三分之一的计划，此前有报道称，这一削减被视为更广泛推动减少净海外移民的一部分。 周四，总理安东尼·艾博内塞在一份声明中表示，政府将“在未来几年继续提供 20,000 名人道主义安置，这符合澳大利亚的人道主义承诺”。 周四上午，《澳大利亚金融评论报》报道称，工党似乎准备在下个财政年度开始时将人道主义安置人数从 20,000 人减少到 13,750 人，并且已将这一减少纳入移民预测。 内政部长托尼·伯克(Tony Burke)发言人周四早些时候告诉SBS新闻，尚未就明年的人道主义援助接收做出最终决定，并将这一过程与明年的预算联系起来。当时他并不排除裁员的可能性。 但阿尔巴尼斯在向 SBS 新闻发表的声明中表示，现有数字“仍然是政府政策”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在世界各地发生多起国际冲突后，工党对人道主义援助接收量进行了一系列增加，使其达到目前的最高水平。 混乱出现之际，预计政府将宣布对其移民政策进行彻底改革。 工党原本预计将在本月早些时候内政部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）在全国新闻俱乐部发表的讲话中透露细节，但由于伯克未能就最佳方法与内阁达成一致，该讲话被取消。 此后，阿尔巴内斯拒绝提供进一步的更新，他周二告诉美国广播公司广播电台，已经制定了“一系列计划”，但仍有“更多工作要做”才能最终确定。他拒绝设定移民公告的时间表，只表示它们会在“适当的时间”发布。 移民目标一直是最近公众辩论的焦点，一国党推行强硬的反移民立场并在民意调查中获胜。 两个主要政党都试图限制自己的移民政策，同时否认这是为了应对小党日益受欢迎的情况。 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒表示，联盟党将把净海外移民（NOM）限制在或低于去年澳大利亚建造的房屋数量。目前的建筑率表明他们的数字将低于 180,000；然而，联盟党尚未宣布将在哪些方面限制移民达到这一数字。 2024-2025 年，NOM 为 306,000。工党的预算预测表明，在该党齐心协力将其从2027年至2028年期间降至225,000人之后

title.en: I left my $300k job to be my own boss. I would have never done it if I knew about this one thing
title.zh: 我辞去了价值 30 万美元的工作，自己当老板。如果我知道这一件事我就不会这么做

summary.en: Julian left a high-paying job to start his own business. He didn't anticipate the difficulties that would come.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich on SBS or SBS On Demand.

I was raised in poverty in western Sydney by a single mum. At dinnertime, she would wait for my four siblings and me to finish eating, and then eat whatever was left over.

My mother had nothing but worked her absolute ass off doing everything from cleaning to hospitality to put us through school and to make sure we were always clothed and fed.

To me, she was proof of the Australian principle: you can achieve your financial goals and transform your life's circumstances if you are willing to make sacrifices and work hard.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Sure, I might not have all the things the other kids in school had, but it didn't matter where I started. If I worked hard, I could still get ahead and achieve the Australian dream .

Because I had to help my mum with our household bills, I started full-time work right out of high school as a junior finance broker on $38,000 while also studying web development full-time.

For the next 10 years, I worked almost every single weekend. I sacrificed and missed out on so much.

I didn't have a passport until I got married at 23; our honeymoon was the first time I went overseas.

I missed many family barbecues, events, and parties so I could set up my own life for my future family as well as support my mum.

I just knew that anything that I could do to help my mum would be worth it after seeing her struggle financially.

By the end of that decade when I was 27, I was running teams of over 20 people and earning upwards of $300k a year.

But I was working 80 hours a week, had no work-life balance, and felt like I was spending so much time building other people's businesses who didn't necessarily appreciate it.

The sacrifices no longer felt aligned with the reward, which made me think it could be different if I were my own boss.

So, in 2020, despite many people telling me it would fail, I decided to risk it all and start my own fintech business.

It was extremely scary starting from zero and paying myself potentially $0; I had no investors — just bootstrapping.

Twice I refinanced the family home, which my wife and I bought at age 22, drawing out hundreds of thousands in equity; I sold all the shares and crypto I had been investing in since I was young; I spent the money upfront that I received from Research and Development grants; and I took out $1+ million in...
body.zh: 您应该投资股票还是房地产？上大学还值得吗，还是应该自己创业？随着财务安全的道路变得越来越模糊，《洞察》询问了有抱负的人们如何取得成功，以及澳大利亚是否是一个积累财富的好国家。观看 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 上的《洞察》剧集《致富》。 我在悉尼西部的贫困中由一位单亲妈妈抚养长大。吃饭的时候，她会等我和四个兄弟姐妹吃完，然后把剩下的吃掉。 我母亲一无所有，除了拼尽全力做一切事情，从清洁到招待，供我们完成学业，并确保我们总是有衣有食。 对我来说，她证明了澳大利亚原则：如果你愿意做出牺牲并努力工作，你就可以实现你的财务目标并改变你的生活状况。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当然，我可能没有学校里其他孩子所拥有的所有东西，但我从哪里开始并不重要。如果我努力工作，我仍然可以出人头地并实现澳大利亚梦。 因为我必须帮助妈妈支付家庭账单，所以我高中一毕业就开始全职工作，担任初级金融经纪人，年薪 38,000 美元，同时还全职学习网络开发。 在接下来的十年里，我几乎每个周末都工作。我牺牲了很多，也错过了很多。 我直到23岁结婚才拿到护照；我们的蜜月是我第一次出国。 我错过了很多家庭烧烤、活动和聚会，这样我就可以为未来的家庭建立自己的生活并支持我的妈妈。 我只知道，在看到妈妈经济困难后，我能为帮助她做的任何事情都是值得的。 到 20 世纪末，我 27 岁的时候，我已经管理着 20 多人的团队，年收入超过 30 万美元。 但我每周工作 80 小时，工作与生活无法平衡，感觉自己花了太多时间建设别人的企业，但别人不一定会欣赏。 牺牲不再与回报相一致，这让我觉得如果我是自己的老板，情况可能会有所不同。 因此，在 2020 年，尽管很多人告诉我这会失败，我还是决定冒一切风险，开始自己的金融科技业务。 从零开始并且可能给自己支付 0 美元是非常可怕的；我没有投资者——只是自力更生。 我曾两次为我和妻子在 22 岁时购买的家庭住宅进行再融资，提取了数十万的资产净值；我卖掉了我从小就投资的所有股票和加密货币；我预先花掉了从研发补助金中获得的资金；我拿出了1+00万美元...

title.en: It was Dolly Parton's proudest legacy. Now an Australian town must keep it alive
title.zh: 达莉·帕顿最引以为傲的遗产。现在，一个澳大利亚小镇必须将其延续下去

summary.en: In Australia, Dolly Parton's legacy extends far beyond music, touching the lives of 151,000 children.
summary.zh: 在澳大利亚，达莉·帕顿的遗产远不止音乐，它触及了15.1万名儿童的生活。

body.en:
In the regional NSW city of Tamworth, more than 3,000 children are reading more books because of Dolly Parton — a mark of Australia's connection to the legendary country singer, actor and philanthropist that runs deeper than one might initially think.

Parton died on Wednesday morning at 80. Tributes have poured in from around the world, but in Tamworth, the loss is more personal.

The city, dubbed the country music capital of Australia, holds an official sister-city bond with Parton's adopted hometown of Nashville and hosted Parton herself on her last Australian tour in 2014.

"It's an incredible nod to us that she would come here when most stars are looking for the big 70,000-seater auditoriums, whereas ours is 5,000 seats," Cheryl Brown, from the Tamworth Country Music Festival, told SBS News.

"So for her to come here, she certainly validated us as the country music capital and that saw us being an important part of country music here in Australia."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But it's her gift of the Imagination Library program, one of Parton's most personal philanthropic projects, that has really transformed Tamworth.

Founded in 1995 as a tribute to her illiterate father, Dolly Parton's Imagination Library is a free book-gifting program — now running across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Ireland, and Australia — that mails new, age-appropriate books to children from birth until they turn five, completely free of charge.

It has gifted more than 300 million books to children since it started 31 years ago. In Australia, more than two million of those books have been delivered to 151,000 children across 480 communities since its launch here in 2013.

In Tamworth, where the program has run since 2019, its ambassador Lisa Rennie says it has fundamentally changed how children relate to reading and literacy.

"Children from birth to the age of five are eligible to receive the books, which are chosen by qualified speech pathologists and early literacy teachers," Rennie told SBS News.

"There are currently about 3,500 children on average on the program in the Tamworth region."

Since 2019, more than 98 per cent of children born in Tamworth have been enrolled.

Families sign up at no cost, ensuring accessibility for those experiencing disadvantage — books are posted to each home each month, and caregivers are also given reading guidance sheets to help foster lifelong reading in families.

About 70 per cent of those books are by Australian authors and 10 per cent by First Nations authors.

body.zh: 在新南威尔士州地区城市塔姆沃思，超过 3,000 名儿童因为多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 的缘故而阅读了更多的书籍——这是澳大利亚与这位传奇乡村歌手、演员和慈善家的联系的标志，其联系比人们最初想象的要深刻。 帕顿于周三早上去世，享年 80 岁。世界各地纷纷表示哀悼，但在塔姆沃思，损失更多的是个人的。 这座被称为澳大利亚乡村音乐之都的城市与帕顿的第二故乡纳什维尔建立了正式的友好城市关系，并在 2014 年接待了帕顿本人最后一次澳大利亚巡演。 塔姆沃斯乡村音乐节的谢丽尔·布朗 (Cheryl Brown) 告诉 SBS 新闻：“当大多数明星都在寻找 70,000 个座位的大礼堂时，她会来到这里，而我们的礼堂只有 5,000 个座位，这对我们来说是一个令人难以置信的认可。” “因此，她来到这里，无疑证明了我们作为乡村音乐之都的地位，这让我们成为澳大利亚乡村音乐的重要组成部分。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但真正改变塔姆沃斯的是她对想象力图书馆计划的捐赠，这是帕顿最具个人色彩的慈善项目之一。 多莉·帕顿的想象力图书馆成立于 1995 年，是为了向她不识字的父亲致敬，这是一个免费的赠书计划，目前在美国、英国、加拿大、爱尔兰和澳大利亚运行，为从出生到五岁的儿童邮寄适合年龄的新书，完全免费。 自 31 年前成立以来，已向儿童赠送了超过 3 亿本书籍。在澳大利亚，自 2013 年推出以来，已向 480 个社区的 151,000 名儿童分发了超过 200 万本此类书籍。 该项目自 2019 年以来一直在塔姆沃思开展，项目大使丽莎·雷尼 (Lisa Rennie) 表示，该项目从根本上改变了儿童与阅读和识字的关系。 雷尼告诉 SBS 新闻：“从出生到五岁的儿童都有资格获得这些书籍，这些书籍是由合格的语言病理学家和早期识字教师挑选的。” “目前塔姆沃思地区平均约有 3,500 名儿童参加该项目。” 自 2019 年以来，塔姆沃思出生的儿童中有超过 98% 已入学。 家庭免费注册，确保那些处于不利地位的人能够获得帮助——每月都会向每个家庭邮寄书籍，并且还向看护者提供阅读指导表，以帮助促进家庭的终身阅读。 其中约 70% 的书籍由澳大利亚作者撰写，10% 由原住民作者撰写。 在澳大利亚提供该计划的澳大利亚联合之路的研究发现，儿童参与了......

title.en: Mid-Autumn lantern spectacle to dazzle visitors
title.zh: 中秋彩灯奇观让游客眼花缭乱

summary.en: A brand-new lantern exhibition showcasing cultural elements from around the world is set to wow locals and tourists at Victoria Park next month, as Hong Kong gets ready to ring in Mid-Autumn Festival. The inaugural International Lantern Spectacular organised by the Hong Kong...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A brand-new lantern exhibition showcasing cultural elements from around the world is set to wow locals and tourists at Victoria Park next month, as Hong Kong gets ready to ring in Mid-Autumn Festival. The inaugural International Lantern Spectacular organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board features thousands of distinctive lanterns from 20 countries and regions, under the theme of "reunion". The exhibition's centrepiece will be the World Lantern Boulevard, where visitors will be treated to silk lanterns from South Korea, the multi-coloured patchwork lanterns of Brazil, and Polish lanterns incorporating traditional folk paper-cutting techniques. The Tourism Board has also invited a team of craftsmen from Nanjing to set up four giant Qinhuai lanterns that will be built with a traditional technique dating back 1,700 years, and is inscribed on the national list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. Another pavilion will showcase hundreds of lanterns handcrafted by local artisans, taking up the shape of rabbits, star fruits and goldfish. The exhibition runs from September 17 to 27, and coincides with the ⁠⁠Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival held by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department in Causeway Bay every year. Revellers are also encouraged to head to nearby Tai Hang for the Fire Dragon Dance between September 24 and 26. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 随着香港即将迎来中秋佳节，一场展示世界各地文化元素的全新灯展将于下个月在维多利亚公园为当地人和游客带来惊喜。香港旅游发展局主办的首届国际彩灯汇演以“团圆”为主题，展示了来自20个国家和地区的数千个各具特色的彩灯。展览的核心将是世界灯笼大道，游客将在这里看到来自韩国的丝绸灯笼、巴西的多彩拼凑灯笼以及融合了传统民间剪纸技术的波兰灯笼。旅游局还邀请了来自南京的工匠团队，以1700年前的传统工艺制作了四盏巨型秦淮灯，并被列入国家非物质文化遗产名录。另一个展馆将展示数百个由当地工匠手工制作的灯笼，形状为兔子、杨桃和金鱼。展览于9月17日至27日举行，恰逢康乐及文化事务署每年在铜锣湾举办的中秋彩灯会。我们还鼓励狂欢者于 9 月 24 日至 26 日期间前往附近的大坑观看舞火龙。编辑：谭咏麟

title.en: 'Refined heat stress system still has room for review'
title.zh: “完善的热应激系统仍有审查空间”

summary.en: Unionist lawmaker Lam Chun-sing said on Thursday that he welcomed the enhanced heat stress at work warning, especially with its almost immediate implementation that could better protect workers during extreme weather conditions next month. His comments came after the Labour...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Unionist lawmaker Lam Chun-sing said on Thursday that he welcomed the enhanced heat stress at work warning, especially with its almost immediate implementation that could better protect workers during extreme weather conditions next month. His comments came after the Labour Department said that starting Friday, two new triggers will be added to the refined system to improve its responsiveness to better safeguard workers. Lam, who also heads the Federation of Hong Kong and Kowloon Labour Unions told RTHK that there is still room for review despite the quick fix. "We appreciate that the Labour Department this time is based on the existing mechanism to do some adjustment, so that we can implement the new mechanism immediately to deal with the situation in September,” Lam said. “But for the long term, we also hope that the Labour Department can see whether we can adopt the Wet Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT), which is internationally recognised." Moreover, instead of solely relying on the system to offer rest times for workers, the lawmaker called on employers to also take into consideration individual situations. For instance, older outdoor workers could be given longer breaks, as they are more prone to heat stroke, Lam added. DAB lawmaker Cheung Pui-kong, meanwhile, described the revamp as a breakthrough for the system. But he pointed out that the calculation formula for the Hong Kong Heat Index had not changed this time, and the refined system has not completely resolved the fundamental issue of significantly underestimating the perceived heat stress outdoor workers have to face. Authorities should also offer subsidies for firms to equip workers with devices that help monitor their heart rate and body temperature to help prevent heat stroke, Cheung said. The Association for the Rights of Industrial Accident Victims, for their part, said the enhanced system could boost sensitivity and trigger the issuance of higher alerts more easily. The government should keep monitoring its operation and carry out a review a year later to see if WBGT should be adopted, it said. The group suggested that the suspension of work should be adopted for all outdoor workers, instead of only allowing those carrying out heavy or very heavy work to enjoy such breaks under the existing system. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 工联议员林俊声周四表示，他对工作中高温压力警告的加强表示欢迎，特别是该警告几乎立即实施，可以在下个月的极端天气条件下更好地保护工人。在他发表上述言论之前，劳工部表示，从周五开始，将在完善的系统中添加两个新的触发器，以提高其响应能力，更好地保护工人。身兼港九工会联合会主席的林郑月娥告诉香港电台，尽管有快速解决方案，但仍有审查的空间。 “我们赞赏劳工处这次在现有机制的基础上做一些调整，以便我们能够立即实施新机制来应对9月份的情况，”林郑月娥说。 “但从长远来看，我们也希望劳工部看看我们是否可以采用国际公认的湿球温度（WBGT）。”此外，立法者呼吁雇主也考虑个人情况，而不是仅仅依靠制度为工人提供休息时间。例如，林补充说，老年户外工人可以得到更长的休息时间，因为他们更容易中暑。与此同时，民建联立法会议员张培刚表示，这次改革是制度的一个突破。但他指出，这次香港炎热指数的计算公式没有改变，细化后的系统并没有完全解决大幅低估户外工作者所面临的热应激感受的根本问题。张说，当局还应该为企业提供补贴，为工人配备有助于监测心率和体温的设备，以帮助预防中暑。工业事故受害者权利协会则表示，增强后的系统可以提高灵敏度，更容易触发更高级别的警报。政府应继续监控其运作，并在一年后进行审查，以决定是否应采用WBGT。该小组建议，应该对所有户外工人实行暂停工作，而不是在现有制度下只允许从事繁重或非常繁重工作的人享受这种休息。谭咏麟编辑

summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Plans to hike fares for Hong Kong’s iconic Star Ferry must take into account its status as an “important asset” as well as the public’s capacity to bear the higher costs, a transport advisor to the government has said. Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The advisor’s comments came amid the ferry operator’s application to increase fees by 30 per cent, which was publicised last month. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Transport Advisory Committee chair Wong Sze-chun said that he and other advisors would balance the needs of the ferry operator with those of the public. “The Star Ferry is an important asset to Hong Kong, so its ability to serve the public is quite vital. We must ensure the continuation of this service,” Wong said in Cantonese after a committee meeting to discuss the proposed fare hike. “At the same time, we have considered the public’s level of acceptance regarding fare increases and their affordability,” he added. “These are the primary factors we weighed during our meeting.” Hong Kong’s Star Ferry. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The Star Ferry runs two cross-harbour routes between Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai and Tsim Sha Tsui and Central. The proposal would see adult single weekday fares rise from HK$5 to HK$6.50, and weekend and public holiday fares go up from HK$6.50 to HK$8.50, according to a Transport and Logistics Bureau submission to the legislature last month. The 138-year-old company cited plans to replace the engines of its vessels in the latter half of this year, the cost of which is estimated to top HK$10 million per ship. It also brought up vessel maintenance and repair costs, rising staff costs, fuel expenditure, interest payments from debt, pier operating costs, and losses exceeding HK$100 million between 2018 and 2023.
body.zh: 政府的一名交通顾问表示，提高香港标志性天星小轮票价的计划必须考虑到其作为“重要资产”的地位以及公众承受更高成本的能力。香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。该顾问发表上述言论之际，轮渡运营商申请将费用增加 30%，该申请已于上个月公布。交通咨询委员会主席黄思俊周四对记者表示，他和其他顾问将平衡渡轮运营商与公众的需求。 “天星小轮是香港的重要资产，因此它为公众提供服务的能力非常重要。我们必须确保这项服务能够持续下去。”黄在一次讨论票价上涨建议的委员会会议后用粤语说道。他补充说：“与此同时，我们考虑了公众对票价上涨的接受程度及其承受能力。” “这些是我们在会议期间权衡的主要因素。”香港的天星小轮。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。天星小轮有两条跨海航线来往尖沙咀与湾仔及尖沙咀与中环。根据运输及物流局上个月向立法机关提交的文件显示，该提议将使成人单人工作日票价从 5 港元上涨至 6.50 港元，周末和公众假期票价从 6.50 港元上涨至 8.50 港元。这家拥有138年历史的公司表示，计划在今年下半年更换船舶发动机，估计每艘船的成本将超过1,000万港元。它还提出了船舶维护和修理成本、员工成本上升、燃油支出、债务利息支付、码头运营成本以及2018年至2023年期间超过1亿港元的损失。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Hong Kong fisherman, 67, dies after suspected lightning strike on sampan off Tseung Kwan O
title.zh: 将军澳舢舨疑遭雷击 67岁香港渔民身亡

summary.en: A Hong Kong fisherman has died after his sampan was suspected of being struck by lightning off the coast of Tseung Kwan O during a heavy rainstorm. The 67-year-old man surnamed Sin was found unconscious on his sampan at sea near the Tseung Kwan O Cross Bay Link, police said on...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A Hong Kong fisherman has died after his sampan was suspected of being struck by lightning off the coast of Tseung Kwan O during a heavy rainstorm. A sampan is suspected of being struck by lightning off the coast of Tseung Kwan O on August 27, 2026. Photo: Screenshot, via Facebook. The 67-year-old man surnamed Sin was found unconscious on his sampan at sea near the Tseung Kwan O Cross Bay Link, police said on Thursday. Police received a report about the man at 9.14am and dispatched a vessel to the scene. At that time, the red rainstorm warning signal was in effect. Footage captured by a passenger on a nearby fishing vessel showed the sampan drifting at sea during heavy rain, while a second clip showed a marine police vessel approaching to carry out a rescue. Police told HKFP that the man had “multiple injuries all over the body” and that he was suspected of being struck by lightning. A police vessel arrives to carry out a rescue. Photo: Screenshot, via Facebook. The man was brought ashore at the Tseung Kwan O South Landing Steps, where he was transferred to an ambulance. He was certified dead at the hospital and an autopsy is underway. The Hong Kong Observatory hoisted the red rainstorm warning signal at 5:05am on Thursday, before lowering it to amber at 9:20am. The amber warning was cancelled at 10:15am. Between Wednesday night and Thursday noon, the weather services recorded more than 5,000 cloud-to-ground lightning strikes. In June, a 59-year-old hiker was struck by lightning while ascending Lantau Island’s highest peak amid a heavy rainstorm. The hiker was rescued in a conscious state and was sent to hospital for treatment.
body.zh: 一名香港渔民在将军澳沿岸暴雨期间，其舢板疑遭雷击，不幸身亡。 2026 年 8 月 27 日，将军澳海岸附近一艘舢板疑似被闪电击中。照片：截图来自 Facebook。警方周四表示，这名 67 岁的单姓男子在将军澳跨湾连接路附近的海上被发现昏迷在舢板上。警方于上午 9 点 14 分接到有关该男子的报告，并派出一艘船只前往现场。当时，红色暴雨警告信号生效。附近一艘渔船上的一名乘客拍摄的视频显示，舢板在大雨中在海上漂流，而第二个视频则显示一艘海警船只靠近进行救援。警方告诉香港新闻社，该男子“全身多处受伤”，怀疑是被雷击中。一艘警船抵达进行救援。照片：截图，来自 Facebook。该男子被带至将军澳南登岸梯，并被转送至救护车。他在医院被证实死亡，尸检正在进行中。香港天文台于周四凌晨5时05分悬挂红色暴雨警告信号，并于上午9时20分降至黄色黄色。上午 10 点 15 分，黄色警报取消。从周三晚上到周四中午，气象部门记录了超过 5,000 次云对地闪电。 6月，一名59岁的徒步旅行者在暴雨中攀登大屿山最高峰时被闪电击中。徒步旅行者获救后神志清醒，并被送往医院接受治疗。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: Shein 帮助伦敦股市躲过一劫尼尔斯·普拉特利

summary.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Candida fungi can burst immune cells and shape-shift to evade immunity
title.zh: the fungi that can burst immune cells and shape-shift to evade immunity

summary.en: Candida auris and Candida albicans are microscopic fungi responsible for nearly a million deaths annually due to life-threatening human infections. The World Health Organization identifies them as among the top four most concerning fungal pathogens globally. While less common in Australia, outbreaks in Europe and the...
summary.zh: 念珠菌（Candida auris）和白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）是微小的真菌，它们引起危及生命的感染，每年在全球造成近百万人死亡。世界卫生组织将这两种真菌列为全球最令人担忧的四种真菌病原体之一。虽然它们在澳大利亚相对少见，但在欧洲和美国的疫情不断蔓延，已迫使重症监护室采取限制措施甚至关闭。

body.en: Candida auris and Candida albicans are microscopic fungi that cause life-threatening human infections, killing almost a million people globally every year. The World Health Organization lists both species among the top four most concerning fungal pathogens in existence, and while relatively uncommon in Australia, growing outbreaks in Europe and the United States have forced restrictions and even closures of intensive care units.
body.zh: 耳念珠菌和白色念珠菌是引起危及生命的人类感染的微小真菌，每年导致全球近一百万人死亡。世界卫生组织将这两种真菌列为现存最受关注的四种真菌病原体之一，虽然在澳大利亚相对罕见，但欧洲和美国的疫情日益严重，迫使重症监护病房受到限制甚至关闭。

reflection.en: The news of Candida fungi's ability to evade our immune systems and cause devastating infections is sobering. It reminds us of the constant battle waged within our bodies and the vulnerability of human life. In times like these, we are called to pray for the sick, for the researchers working on treatments, and for wisdom in protecting the most vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 念珠菌能够逃避免疫系统并引起毁灭性感染的消息令人警醒。它提醒我们身体内部持续进行的战斗以及生命的脆弱。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召为病人祈祷，为那些致力于研究治疗方法的科研人员祈祷，并祈求智慧来保护最脆弱的人群。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: France relaxes strict cheese-making rules after prolonged drought
title.zh: 法国放松严格奶酪制作规定以应对长期干旱

summary.en: Makers of some of France's most famous cheeses are receiving waivers on where their herds graze due to a lack of grass caused by a prolonged drought. This temporary relaxation of rules allows farmers to use feed from outside their designated geographical zones.
summary.zh: 由于长期干旱导致牧草短缺，法国一些最著名奶酪的生产商获得了关于牧群放牧地点的豁免。这项暂时的规定放松允许农民使用来自其指定地理区域以外的饲料。

body.en:
France has temporarily relaxed rules for making some of its best-known cheeses after the summer drought drastically reduced the amount of grass available to feed milk herds.

Government decrees to grant dispensations to manufacturers of Abondance, Beaufort and Comté cheeses - which come from mountains in eastern France - appeared on Wednesday.

Several other cheeses are expected to receive similar waivers, allowing farmers to feed livestock with grass and hay brought in from outside their strict geographical zone.

These include Cantal, Bleu d'Auvergne, Fourme d'Ambert, Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage, Reblochon and the goats cheese Rocamadour.

The National Institute for Origin and Quality (INAO), which regulates France's labels of origin, has also approved temporary changes to the rules for other protected produce because of the effects of the summer heat.

Products that will benefit include some types of Calvados and cider from Normandy, Crémant d'Alsace fizzy wine, lamb from Poitou-Charentes, and Reine-Claude plums.

Certificates of origin allow farmers to sell at a premium, but they come with strict regulations governing the location and method of production.

The aim is to preserve the unique identity of cheeses, wines and other foodstuffs, supposedly linked to their particular terroir - a French concept that links locality and tradition.

Because of a 2026 drought - which the INAO now describes as "historic" - farmers are being allowed to bend the rules for a short period.

Makers of Abondance cheese in the Alps, for example, will be authorised to reduce the amount of pastured grass in their animals' diet from 50% to 15%. They will be entitled to import forage from outside their zone, and use some supplements.

Makers of Comté cheese in the Jura mountains will be able to replace the local green maize they usually give to their cattle with maize from elsewhere.

The derogations are allowed in French and European law for periods of exceptional weather. Similar measures came in after the dry summer of 2022.

It will be interesting to see if the changes lead to any detectable change in the taste or quality of the cheeses - or to the quantity produced and how it is priced.

Longer term, the measures raise questions over the viability of the existing labels of origin in France and elsewhere.

If changing climate means that certain foodstuffs can no longer be produced in their traditional localities, then the idea of terroir will be stretched to its limits.
body.zh: 夏季干旱大幅减少了可用于喂养奶牛群的草量，法国暂时放宽了制作一些最著名奶酪的规定。 周三，政府颁布了法令，向来自法国东部山区的 Abondance、Beaufort 和 Comté 奶酪制造商提供特许。 其他几种奶酪预计也将获得类似的豁免，允许农民用从其严格地理区域之外引进的草和干草喂养牲畜。 其中包括 Cantal、Bleu d'Auvergne、Fourme d'Ambert、Bleu du Vercors-Sassenage、Reblochon 和 Rocamadour 山羊奶酪。 由于夏季炎热的影响，负责监管法国原产地标签的国家原产地和质量研究所 (INAO) 也批准对其他受保护产品的规则进行临时修改。 受益的产品包括来自诺曼底的某些类型的卡尔瓦多斯苹果酒和苹果酒、阿尔萨斯起泡酒、来自普瓦图-夏朗德的羊肉以及雷讷-克洛德李子。 原产地证书允许农民以溢价出售，但它们对生产地点和方法有严格的规定。 其目的是保留奶酪、葡萄酒和其他食品的独特特性，据称这些特性与其特定的风土条件有关——这是一个将地方和传统联系起来的法国概念。 由于 2026 年发生的干旱（INAO 现在将其称为“历史性的”），农民被允许在短时间内改变规则。 例如，阿尔卑斯山的 Abondance 奶酪制造商将被授权将其动物饮食中的牧草含量从 50% 减少到 15%。他们将有权从其区域外进口饲料，并使用一些补充剂。 汝拉山区的孔泰奶酪制造商将能够用其他地方的玉米代替他们通常给牛群喂的当地绿色玉米。 法国和欧洲法律允许在特殊天气期间进行减损。 2022 年干燥的夏季之后也采取了类似的措施。 看看这些变化是否会导致奶酪的味道或质量发生任何可检测到的变化，或者产量和定价的变化，将会很有趣。 从长远来看，这些措施引发了人们对法国和其他地方现有原产地标签的可行性的质疑。 如果气候变化意味着某些食品不能再在其传统产地生产，那么风土的概念将延伸至其极限。

reflection.en: The prolonged drought in France has forced a temporary change in the strict rules governing cheese production, allowing farmers to feed their herds with hay brought from outside their traditional grazing areas. This situation highlights the vulnerability of even well-established traditions to the harsh realities of nature, reminding us that human endeavors...
reflection.zh: 法国的长期干旱迫使奶酪生产的严格规定暂时放松，允许农民使用来自传统放牧区以外的干草喂养他们的牛群。这种情况凸显了即使是根深蒂固的传统也容易受到严酷自然现实的影响，提醒我们人类的努力常常受到我们无法控制的力量的制约。...

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: What caused the flooding in Nepal?
title.zh: 是什么导致了尼泊尔的洪水？

summary.en: Experts point to 'glacial collapse' as the trigger for deadly floods that have swept through parts of Nepal and Tibet.
summary.zh: 专家指出“冰川崩塌”是席卷尼泊尔和西藏部分地区致命洪水的诱因。

body.en:
Scientists are pointing to a glacier collapse as a key cause of the deadly floods that have swept through parts of Nepal and Tibet.

The glacier in question lies to the north of Langtang Lirung, a peak more than 7,000 metres above sea level in the Himalayas.

As Mark Poynting reports, it's not yet clear what caused the glacier to collapse, but some scientists say a massive landslide could have taken part of the glacier with it.
body.zh: 科学家指出，冰川崩塌是席卷尼泊尔和西藏部分地区致命洪水的主要原因。 相关冰川位于喜马拉雅山脉海拔7000多米的朗塘丽荣山峰以北。 正如马克·波印廷报道的那样，目前尚不清楚是什么原因导致冰川崩塌，但一些科学家表示，大规模的山体滑坡可能导致部分冰川消失。

reflection.en: The Himalayas, a region of immense natural beauty and spiritual significance, are showing signs of distress. The collapse of a glacier, leading to devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, serves as a stark reminder that the natural world itself groans under the weight of unseen forces and changes. This event calls us to reflect on our relationship with...
reflection.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉，这片拥有壮丽自然美景和精神意义的土地，正显露出痛苦的迹象。冰川的崩塌引发了尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性洪水，这有力地提醒我们，受造界本身也在承受着看不见的力量和变化的重压。这一事件促使我们反思与受造界的关係以及万物的相互关联。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Tsunami of dirt: What caused Nepal's deadly glacial flood?
title.zh: 泥石流如海啸：尼泊尔致命冰川洪水的原因是什么？

summary.en: Over 150 people are dead and hundreds more are missing after a massive wave of water, ice, mud, and rock surged down the Bhote Koshi River valley in Nepal, a crucial route connecting Kathmandu and Lhasa. The event occurred with little warning, and shocking footage shows the debris-laden flash flood.
summary.zh: 在巨大的水、冰、泥和岩石组成的浪潮沿着连接加德满都和拉萨的重要通道——尼泊尔的博特科西河谷倾泻而下后，已有超过150人死亡，数百人失踪。此次事件发生时几乎没有预警，令人震惊的视频显示了满载碎屑的洪水。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

More than 150 people are dead and hundreds more are missing after an enormous wave of water, ice, mud and rock cascaded more than 170 kilometers (106 miles) down the Bhote Koshi River valley in Nepal. The valley is the main link between Kathmandu in Nepal and Lhasa in Tibet. At least 34 Australians are missing. There was little warning.

Footage of the debris-laden flash flood is shocking. It is, unfortunately, not surprising.

As an expert in glaciers, I have tracked their accelerating retreat around the world as they melt—and the disasters that can follow. Early analysis suggests the abrupt collapse of a glacier triggered the disaster.

As climate change intensifies, glaciers worldwide are melting—even in high regions such as the Himalayas . The Himalayas are especially vulnerable because the steep slopes of many of these very tall mountains are made of permafrost—rock and soil frozen for centuries. As temperatures rise, these slopes are beginning to melt or destabilize. If an earthquake or slope failure occurs, it can trigger a sudden and devastating debris flow.

It's too early to say this was the exact cause. But we know that the great ice stores of the Himalayas—known as the world's " third pole " because it contains the largest amount of snow and ice after the Arctic and Antarctic—are no longer safe.

What happened in Nepal is likely due to an enormous ice-and-rock landslide sweeping down a mountain pass and gathering up ice, water, rock, trees and dirt.

The landslide was so large it was originally thought to be an earthquake, as the seismic energy registered as a magnitude 4.4 quake on seismographs.

By the time it reached Gyirong Port—a China–Nepal border crossing—the wall of debris resembled a tsunami of dirt. Early estimates suggest the wave may have been 30 meters high (98 feet).

Sometimes, disasters like these can be caused when glacial meltwater trapped in a lake by a landslide breaks free. One of these events—known as a glacial lake outburst flood— hit Nepal in 2024.

But early analysis suggests this isn't the case here. Satellite imagery suggests the landslide may have carved away large parts of a glacier, triggering its collapse .

We don't know yet what caused the glacier to collapse. But glaciers worldwide are broadly in retreat —and flood and debris-flow disasters can follow.

A smaller flood hit the same...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一股巨大的水流、冰、泥浆和岩石沿着尼泊尔博特科西河谷倾泻而下，绵延 170 多公里（106 英里），造成 150 多人死亡，数百人失踪。该山谷是尼泊尔加德满都和西藏拉萨之间的主要纽带。至少有 34 名澳大利亚人失踪。几乎没有任何警告。 充满碎片的山洪暴发的镜头令人震惊。不幸的是，这并不奇怪。 作为冰川专家，我追踪了冰川融化时在世界各地加速退缩的情况，以及随之而来的灾难。早期分析表明，冰川突然崩塌引发了这场灾难。 随着气候变化加剧，全世界的冰川都在融化——甚至在喜马拉雅山等高海拔地区也是如此。喜马拉雅山尤其脆弱，因为许多高山的陡坡都是由永久冻土构成的，即冻结了几个世纪的岩石和土壤。随着温度升高，这些斜坡开始融化或不稳定。如果发生地震或斜坡崩塌，可能会引发突然的、毁灭性的泥石流。 现在说这是确切原因还为时过早。但我们知道，喜马拉雅山的巨大冰库——被称为世界“第三极”，因为它拥有继北极和南极之后最多的冰雪量——不再安全。 尼泊尔发生的事情很可能是由于一场巨大的冰石山体滑坡席卷山口，聚集了冰、水、岩石、树木和泥土。 此次滑坡规模如此之大，最初被认为是一场地震，因为地震仪记录的地震能量为 4.4 级地震。 当它到达中国和尼泊尔边境口岸吉隆口岸时，废墟就像海啸般的泥土。初步估计，海浪可能高达 30 米（98 英尺）。 有时，当山体滑坡困在湖中的冰川融水释放出来时，可能会造成此类灾难。其中一场被称为冰川湖溃决洪水的事件于 2024 年袭击了尼泊尔。 但早期分析表明，这里的情况并非如此。卫星图像显示，山体滑坡可能侵蚀了大部分冰川，引发冰川崩塌。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者探索科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。订阅我们的免费新闻通讯，每天或每周获取重要突破、创新和研究的最新动态。 我们还不知道是什么导致冰川崩塌。但世界范围内的冰川普遍在退缩，洪水和泥石流灾害可能随之而来。 一场较小的洪水也袭击了同样的地方……

reflection.en: The devastating glacial flood in Nepal, which swept away lives and livelihoods, serves as a stark reminder of the fragility of our world. The groaning of creation, as described in Romans 8:22, is felt in such moments of natural disaster, where the earth itself seems to cry out in pain.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的冰川洪水冲走了生命和生计，它警示我们这个世界的脆弱。正如罗马书8:22所描述的，受造之物在这样的自然灾害时刻发出叹息，大地本身似乎在痛苦中哭喊。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Researchers reveal the unique 'tagging' mechanism that guides the sleeping brain in remembering key thoughts
title.zh: 研究人员揭示了指导睡眠中大脑记忆关键思想的独特“标记”机制

summary.en: Researchers have identified the neural mechanism that determines which daily experiences are stored as long-term memories during sleep. This mechanism helps the brain prioritize important information and discard irrelevant details, addressing the challenge of limited memory capacity amidst a constant influx of data.
summary.zh: 研究人员已经确定了在睡眠期间将哪些日常经历存储为长期记忆的神经机制。该机制有助于大脑优先处理重要信息并丢弃不相关细节，从而解决了在持续不断的数据涌入中，大脑有限的记忆容量所带来的挑战。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Why do we remember certain moments while forgetting others? Every day, our minds are bombarded with thousands of pieces of information, yet our brains have a limited capacity to consolidate these experiences into lasting memories. This means we need a way to hold on to what is most important and disregard irrelevant details.

Now researchers at the University of York have uncovered the neural mechanism that instructs the brain which daily experiences to save as long-term memories during sleep.

In the study published in the journal PLOS Biology , researchers analyzed brainwave activity while participants were learning new associations between words and pictures. It is already known that after learning, sleep plays a central role in strengthening new learning into long-term memories.

The researchers discovered that during learning, the brain "tags" certain memories for processing during later sleep. This tagging provides a way for the sleeping brain to strengthen only what is deemed important to remember.

This tagging was linked to a specific brainwave pattern known as a "theta rhythm" present during learning. The strength of these theta rhythms provided an instructional cue to help organize brain activity during sleep.

Those memories with a particularly strong theta rhythm during learning were preferentially strengthened during sleep, ultimately leading to better memory recall, the scientists said.

They say the findings show that the brain prioritizes and strengthens important information by using specific neural signals during learning that guide memory-strengthening processes during sleep. Determining what our brains decide to strengthen during sleep could help us better understand why some individuals are vulnerable to conditions such as depression.

Lead author Dr. Dan Denis, from the Department of Psychology at the University of York, said, "It has long been known that a good night's sleep is important for processing memories.

"How the brain decides what is important to remember and what can be forgotten is still a mystery. These new findings help to answer that question by uncovering for the first time a signature of neural activity that instructs the brain which experiences to process during sleep and form into long-term memories."

"If we remembered everything that we experienced, our brains would quickly reach system overload. By selectively prioritizing important events in our lives, be they emotionally salient or important for the future, we are able to use our past experiences to help guide our interactions in the world."

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 为什么我们会记住某些时刻而忘记其他时刻？每天，我们的大脑都会受到成千上万条信息的轰炸，但我们的大脑将这些经历整合成持久记忆的能力有限。这意味着我们需要一种方法来抓住最重要的东西并忽略不相关的细节。 现在，约克大学的研究人员发现了一种神经机制，可以指示大脑将日常经历在睡眠期间保存为长期记忆。 在《PLOS Biology》杂志上发表的研究中，研究人员分析了参与者学习单词和图片之间新关联时的脑电波活动。众所周知，学习后，睡眠在强化新学习到长期记忆方面发挥着核心作用。 研究人员发现，在学习过程中，大脑会“标记”某些记忆，以便在以后的睡眠中进行处理。这种标记为睡眠中的大脑提供了一种只强化那些被认为重要的记忆的方法。 这种标记与学习过程中存在的一种被称为“theta 节奏”的特定脑电波模式相关联。这些 θ 节律的强度提供了指导线索，帮助组织睡眠期间的大脑活动。 科学家们说，那些在学习过程中具有特别强的θ节律的记忆在睡眠期间优先得到加强，最终导致更好的记忆回忆。 他们说，研究结果表明，大脑在学习过程中使用特定的神经信号来优先考虑和强化重要信息，从而指导睡眠期间的记忆强化过程。确定我们的大脑在睡眠期间决定加强什么可以帮助我们更好地理解为什么有些人容易患上抑郁症等疾病。 约克大学心理学系的主要作者丹·丹尼斯博士说：“人们早就知道，良好的睡眠对于处理记忆非常重要。 “大脑如何决定什么是重要的要记住的，什么是可以忘记的仍然是一个谜。这些新发现首次揭示了神经活动的特征，指导大脑处理睡眠期间的经历并形成长期记忆，从而有助于回答这个问题。” “如果我们记住我们经历过的一切，我们的大脑很快就会达到系统过载。通过有选择地优先考虑生活中的重要事件，无论是在情感上突出的还是对未来重要的，我们都能够利用过去的经验来帮助指导我们在世界上的互动。” 研究人员指出，虽然...

reflection.en: The human brain's intricate design for memory, as revealed in this study, points to the profound wisdom embedded in creation. Observing how our minds process and retain information during sleep invites us to marvel at the 'work of the hands' of our Creator, as Job suggests. It reminds us that even in the quiet hours of rest, a divine order is at play,...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了人脑用于记忆的复杂设计，这指向了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。观察我们在睡眠中如何处理和保留信息，能引导我们惊叹于创造者的“手工作品”，正如约伯所言。它提醒我们，即使在宁静的休息时刻，神圣的秩序也在发挥作用，塑造着我们的理解和经历。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: XY or ZW? Gecko chromosomes reveal evolution's hidden playbook
title.zh: XY还是ZW？壁虎染色体揭示了进化的隐藏剧本

summary.en: The article explores the diversity of sex determination across the animal kingdom, contrasting human XY chromosomes, bird ZW chromosomes, and temperature-dependent sex determination in many reptiles, suggesting that studying these differences can reveal evolutionary patterns.
summary.zh: 文章探讨了动物界性别决定方式的多样性，对比了人类的XY染色体、鸟类的ZW染色体以及许多爬行动物依赖温度决定的方式，并提出研究这些差异可以揭示进化的模式。

body.en: Why do humans rely on XY chromosomes to determine sex, while birds use ZW—and many reptiles use neither, letting temperature decide instead? Sex determination is remarkably diverse across the animal kingdom. In genotypic sex determination (GSD), sex is encoded in the genome: XX individuals are female and XY males in humans and most mammals, while in the ZW system, found in birds and some reptiles, males are ZZ and females ZW.
body.zh: 为什么人类依靠 XY 染色体来决定性别，而鸟类则使用 ZW 染色体——而许多爬行动物两者都不使用，而是让温度来决定性别？整个动物界的性别决定是非常多样化的。在基因型性别决定（GSD）中，性别是在基因组中编码的：在人类和大多数哺乳动物中，XX个体是雌性，XY个体是雄性，而在鸟类和一些爬行动物中发现的ZW系统中，雄性是ZZ，雌性是ZW。

reflection.en: The intricate ways life perpetuates itself, as seen in the varied sex determination systems of geckos and other creatures, offer profound lessons. By observing the natural world, we can indeed learn much about the Creator's wisdom and the unfolding of life's grand design.
reflection.zh: 生命延续的复杂方式，如壁虎和其他生物多样的性别决定系统所示，提供了深刻的教训。通过观察自然界，我们确实可以学到许多关于创造者智慧和生命宏伟蓝图展开的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: El Niños have been more intense over the last 40 years than in the previous 1,000 years, coral records reveal
title.zh: 科罗拉多州记录显示，过去 40 年的厄尔尼诺现象比过去 1000 年的更强烈

summary.en: A University of Michigan study, using ancient coral records, has found that El Niño events have intensified by nearly 40% in the last four decades compared to the preindustrial era, with current events being the strongest in the last millennium.
summary.zh: 一项密歇根大学的研究利用古代珊瑚记录发现，与工业化前时代相比，过去四十年来厄尔尼诺事件的强度增加了近 40%，而当前的厄尔尼诺现象是有记录以来最强烈的。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As an El Niño of historic proportions is taking shape in the tropical Pacific, a University of Michigan study has found that El Niño events have become nearly 40% stronger in the last 40 years than they were in the preindustrial era.

In fact, the study, which examined modern and ancient corals in the Galápagos Islands, found that El Niño events in the last four decades were stronger than any in the 1,000 years before about 1850, when humans began affecting the climate with greenhouse gases.

"We don't see a time in the past where El Niños have been as strong as today, and we show that the strength of El Niño changes in parallel with warming global temperatures," said lead author Julia Cole, professor and chair of the U-M Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences. "Our findings tell us that the big El Niño events of the last 40 years are not normal in the context of the last thousand years."

El Niño is a natural phenomenon that, every few years, causes the tropical Pacific to become warmer than usual. Under normal conditions, trade winds blow along the equator from east to west. This pushes warm water from South America toward Australia. But when the trade winds weaken, warm water spreads eastward, back toward South America, kicking off an El Niño event.

The atmospheric circulation responds as heavy rainfall shifts from Indonesia into the central Pacific, leaving the western Pacific in drought. This weakens the trade winds further, locking in El Niño conditions that can persist for one to two years. These temperature and precipitation fluctuations originate in the tropical Pacific, but they affect weather all over the world.

Storm tracks over the U.S. shift southward, bringing more rain to the desert Southwest and less to the Northwest. Similar shifts around the world lead to droughts and flooding that bring disease, crop failure, wildfires and other crises that affect people's health and well-being.

"The question is not whether the current El Niño will happen, but how bad it is going to be, and how bad the impacts will be?" Cole said. "This event is superimposed on global warming, and it's likely to supercharge the temperature increase that we would normally see from greenhouse gases. There are forecasts that we might get as hot as 1.7 or 1.8 degrees Celsius above preindustrial temperatures, which is quite a bit higher than the current record."

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着热带太平洋地区正在形成历史性的厄尔尼诺现象，密歇根大学的一项研究发现，过去 40 年厄尔尼诺现象的强度比工业化前时代强了近 40%。 事实上，这项研究检查了加拉帕戈斯群岛的现代和古代珊瑚，发现过去四十年的厄尔尼诺事件比大约 1850 年（当时人类开始用温室气体影响气候）之前 1000 年的任何一次事件都要强烈。 主要作者、密西根大学地球与环境科学系教授兼系主任朱莉娅·科尔 (Julia Cole) 表示：“我们过去没有见过像今天这样强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，而且我们表明，厄尔尼诺现象的强度与全球气温变暖同时发生变化。” “我们的研究结果告诉我们，过去 40 年发生的大型厄尔尼诺事件在过去一千年的背景下并不正常。” 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然现象，每隔几年就会导致热带太平洋比平时变暖。正常情况下，信风沿赤道自东向西吹。这将温暖的海水从南美洲推向澳大利亚。但当信风减弱时，温暖的海水向东扩散，回到南美洲，引发厄尔尼诺现象。 随着强降雨从印度尼西亚转移到太平洋中部，大气环流做出反应，使西太平洋陷入干旱。这进一步削弱了贸易风，锁定了可能持续一到两年的厄尔尼诺现象。这些温度和降水波动起源于热带太平洋，但它们影响世界各地的天气。 美国上空的风暴路径向南移动，给西南沙漠带来更多降雨，而给西北沙漠带来更少降雨。世界各地的类似变化导致干旱和洪水，带来疾病、农作物歉收、野火和其他影响人们健康和福祉的危机。 “问题不在于当前的厄尔尼诺现象是否会发生，而在于它会有多严重，影响会有多严重？”科尔说道。 “这一事件与全球变暖相叠加，很可能会加剧我们通常会看到的温室气体带来的气温上升。有预测称，我们的气温可能会比工业化前的气温高出1.7或1.8摄氏度，这比目前的记录要高很多。” 为了研究历史上的厄尔尼诺现象，科尔和其他研究人员从加拉帕戈斯群岛的 13 个珊瑚中采集了岩芯样本，其中包括现存的珊瑚群落和古代珊瑚巨石。珊瑚生长 1 至 2 厘米（0.4 至...

We are called to be stewards of creation, recognizing that its well-being is intertwined with our own and with the Creator's purposes. May we approach these environmental shifts with wisdom, humility, and a renewed commitment to caring...
reflection.zh: 正如这项研究揭示了厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，地球本身似乎也在承受着快速变化的重负而呻吟。我们被呼召成为受造界的管家，认识到它的福祉与我们自身以及造物主的旨意息息相关。愿我们以智慧、谦卑和对所托付的世界的关怀，来应对这些环境的变化。

title.en: Exploring how bumble bee queens coordinate chemical signals
title.zh: 探索大黄蜂蜂后如何协调化学信号

summary.en: New research by SUNY Polytechnic Institute (SUNY Poly) Assistant Professor of Biology Dr. Margarita Orlova is providing new insight into how bumblebee queens communicate through chemical signals and how those signals change throughout their lives.
summary.zh: 纽约州立理工学院（SUNY Poly）生物学助理教授玛格丽塔·奥尔洛娃博士的最新研究，为我们深入了解大黄蜂蜂后如何通过化学信号进行交流以及这些信号在其一生中如何变化提供了新的见解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New research by SUNY Polytechnic Institute (SUNY Poly) Assistant Professor of Biology Dr. Margarita Orlova is providing new insight into how bumblebee queens communicate through chemical signals and how those signals change throughout their lives.

Orlova collaborated with Dr. Etya Amsalem of Penn State University on the paper, "A Common Regulatory Architecture Shapes Queen Chemical Signals Across Multiple Exocrine Sites," published in the Journal of Chemical Ecology .

Insects use chemicals produced by different glands and other sites throughout their bodies to communicate information such as identity, health and reproductive status. While these chemical sources are typically studied individually, Orlova and Amsalem examined whether changes occurring across different sites within the same insect may be coordinated.

The researchers studied bumblebee queens across three key life stages: newly emerged unmated queens, young queens beginning to establish colonies, and older queens raising new queens and males. They analyzed chemical secretions from multiple sites to determine how their composition changed as queens aged and transitioned into reproduction.

The study found coordinated chemical changes across multiple sites as the queens aged. Among the most notable findings, older queens produced shorter hydrocarbons and esters, while several other components of their chemical profiles also changed with mating, age and reproductive status. These patterns suggest that chemical signals produced in different parts of the body may be influenced by shared biological processes rather than operating independently.

The findings provide a broader perspective on insect chemical communication, suggesting that examining a bee's combined chemical profile may reveal more biologically meaningful information than studying individual glands in isolation. The research also opens opportunities to further study the physiological mechanisms that coordinate these signals and how chemical communication has evolved across different insect species.

Margarita Orlova et al, A Common Regulatory Architecture Shapes Queen Chemical Signals Across Multiple Exocrine Sites, Journal of Chemical Ecology (2026). DOI: 10.1007/s10886-026-01750-2

BA art history, MA material culture. Former museum editor, paramedic, and transplant coordinator. Editing for Science X since 2021. Full profile →

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success. Full profile →
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 纽约州立大学理工学院 (SUNY Poly) 生物学助理教授 Margarita Orlova 博士的新研究为大黄蜂蜂王如何通过化学信号进行交流以及这些信号在其一生中如何变化提供了新的见解。 Orlova 与宾夕法尼亚州立大学的 Etya Amsalem 博士合作撰写了论文“A Common Regulatory Architecture Shapes Queen Chemical Signals Across Multiple Exocrine Sites”，发表在《化学生态学杂志》上。 昆虫利用不同腺体和全身其他部位产生的化学物质来传达身份、健康和生殖状态等信息。虽然这些化学来源通常是单独研究的，但奥尔洛娃和阿姆萨勒姆研究了同一昆虫不同部位发生的变化是否可以协调。 研究人员对大黄蜂蜂王的三个关键生命阶段进行了研究：新出现的未交配蜂王、年轻蜂王开始建立蜂群以及年老蜂王抚养新蜂王和雄蜂。他们分析了多个地点的化学分泌物，以确定随着蜂王衰老和繁殖阶段，它们的成分如何变化。 研究发现，随着蜂后年龄的增长，多个地点发生协调的化学变化。最值得注意的发现之一是，年长的蜂王产生的碳氢化合物和酯较短，而其化学特征的其他一些成分也随着交配、年龄和繁殖状态而变化。这些模式表明，身体不同部位产生的化学信号可能受到共同生物过程的影响，而不是独立运作。 这些发现为昆虫化学通讯提供了更广阔的视角，表明检查蜜蜂的综合化学特征可能比单独研究单个腺体揭示更多具有生物学意义的信息。该研究还为进一步研究协调这些信号的生理机制以及化学通讯如何在不同昆虫物种之间进化提供了机会。 Margarita Orlova 等人，一种共同的监管架构塑造了跨多个外分泌位点的化学信号，《化学生态学杂志》（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1007/s10886-026-01750-2 艺术史学士，物质文化硕士。前博物馆编辑、护理人员和移植协调员。自 2021 年起为 Science X 编辑。完整档案 → 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The intricate communication systems of creatures like bumblebees offer a window into the Creator's wisdom. As Dr. Orlova's research reveals the complex chemical language of queen bees, we are reminded that observing the natural world can indeed teach us much about order, design, and the marvelous ways life sustains itself. This exploration into the 'how' of...
reflection.zh: 像大黄蜂这样的生物复杂的交流系统，为我们提供了窥见造物主智慧的窗口。奥尔洛娃博士的研究揭示了蜂后复杂的化学语言，这提醒我们，观察自然界确实能教会我们许多关于秩序、设计以及生命维持自身的奇妙方式。 这种对大黄蜂交流“如何”的探索，呼应了《约伯记》中古老的智慧，鼓励我们去问“走兽、飞鸟”，它们会教导我们。大自然是一位深刻的老师，揭示了雅伟精妙的创造之工。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: 'We want them home': Families await word on loved ones missing in Nepal floods
title.zh: “我们希望他们回家”：家人焦急等待尼泊尔洪水失踪亲人的消息

summary.en: Over 1,300 people are missing, including dozens of Americans and Canadians, following deadly flash floods and mudslides in Nepal. Nepali authorities report over 380 fatalities. Families are anxiously awaiting news of their loved ones, with some having last spoken to them just before the disaster.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔发生致命的洪水和泥石流后，有超过1300人失踪，其中包括数十名美国和加拿大人。尼泊尔当局报告称已有超过380人死亡。家属们焦急地等待亲人的消息，其中一些人在灾难发生前不久才与他们通过话。

body.en:
Hundreds of foreign nationals are desperately waiting to hear from loved ones thought to be caught in the deadly flash flood and mudslide along the Nepal-Tibet border.

Sisters Shreya and Ashna Ahuja are among those anxiously waiting for some news of their parents, Deepak and Madhu Ahuja, who had had travelled from Texas to Mount Kailash on a group pilgrimage.

"It's only been one day, but it has felt like much longer," the sisters tell the BBC. "We just love them a lot and want them to come home." One of the siblings spoke to their parents just before the floods struck.

More than 1,300 people are missing, including dozens of Americans and Canadians. Nepali authorities say more than 380 people have died.

About 90 US citizens may have been impacted by the floods, the State Department said on Thursday, confirming that three Americans had been rescued.

The Ahuja sisters have contacted the State Department and US embassies in Delhi, Nepal and China, but they say they have no concrete information on the whereabouts of their parents.

The region is a pilgrimage site for Hindus and Buddhists, and visited by tens of thousands of pilgrims each year.

Radhika Sharma's parents, Ramesh Sharma, 65 and Neelam Sharma, 64, two US citizens who live in New York City, were also travelling to Mount Kailash in the Kathmandu region when the disaster struck.

"I am just trying to find them, I don't have any answers," Radhika Sharma told the BBC. Sharma is typically in frequent contact with her parents, often texting multiple times during the day.

"The last we know is they were at the border at 8 am, so about an hour before the floods," she said. "And we are hoping that they made it to the Tibet side."

Sharma, who has been in contact with the US embassies in in Beijing and Kathmandu, said: "No one has any answers."

She has also connected with other Americans who are in a similar situation, to support one another and consolidate information.

Prabhath Sajeepa is another US citizen who went missing after the flood hit. Sajeepa works for a software company in California, and was also on the sacred pilgrimage to Mount Kailash.

"It has been terrible. I hope he is somewhere safe," his niece, Kavya Koulagi Jayatheertha, told the BBC. "We are hoping for good news."

The State Department said that the US embassy in Nepal was working closely with local tour agencies and authorities to assist affected Americans.

Officials did not provide figures or additional details regarding the Americans affected for privacy reasons.

Canada's foreign office said it was aware 30 Canadians and permanent residents in Nepal and the Tibet region whose whereabouts and well-being had not yet been confirmed.

"Given the extremely difficult circumstances on the ground, this number may fluctuate as...
body.zh: 数百名外国人正在绝望地等待亲人的消息，他们被认为在尼泊尔和西藏边境发生致命的山洪和泥石流中丧生。 Shreya 和 Ashna Ahuja 姐妹也在焦急地等待父母 Deepak 和 Madhu Ahuja 的消息，他们从德克萨斯州前往冈仁波齐峰进行集体朝圣。 姐妹俩告诉英国广播公司：“这只是一天，但感觉已经很久了。” “我们非常爱他们，希望他们回家。”洪水袭来之前，其中一位兄弟姐妹与父母进行了交谈。 超过 1,300 人失踪，其中包括数十名美国人和加拿大人。尼泊尔当局表示，已有 380 多人死亡。 美国国务院周四表示，大约 90 名美国公民可能受到洪水影响，并确认三名美国人已获救。 阿胡贾姐妹已经联系了国务院以及美国驻德里、尼泊尔和中国大使馆，但他们表示没有关于父母下落的具体信息。 该地区是印度教徒和佛教徒的朝圣地，每年都有数以万计的朝圣者前来参观。 拉迪卡·夏尔马 (Radhika Sharma) 的父母拉梅什·夏尔马 (Ramesh Sharma)，65 岁和尼拉姆·夏尔马 (Neelam Sharma)，64 岁，是居住在纽约市的两名美国公民，灾难发生时，他们也在前往加德满都地区的冈仁波齐峰。 “我只是想找到他们，我没有任何答案，”拉迪卡·夏尔马告诉英国广播公司。夏尔马通常与父母联系频繁，经常在白天多次发短信。 “我们最后知道的是，他们是早上 8 点到达边境，也就是洪水发生前大约一个小时，”她说。 “我们希望他们能够到达西藏一侧。” 夏尔马一直与美国驻北京和加德满都大使馆保持联系，他说：“没有人有任何答案。” 她还与其他处于类似情况的美国人建立联系，相互支持并整合信息。 普拉巴斯·萨吉帕（Prabhath Sajeepa）是另一位在洪水袭击后失踪的美国公民。萨吉帕在加州一家软件公司工作，当时也在冈仁波齐山朝圣。 “这太可怕了。我希望他在安全的地方，”他的侄女 Kavya Koulagi Jayatheertha 告诉 BBC。 “我们希望听到好消息。” 美国国务院表示，美国驻尼泊尔大使馆正在与当地旅行社和当局密切合作，以协助受影响的美国人。 出于隐私原因，官员们没有提供有关受影响美国人的数据或更多细节。 加拿大外交部表示，已知有30名加拿大人和尼泊尔和西藏地区的永久居民，他们的下落和健康状况尚未得到确认。 “鉴于当地极其困难的情况，这个数字可能会波动......

reflection.en: The desperate wait for news of loved ones lost in the Nepal floods underscores the profound human need for connection and the anguish of separation. In times of such uncertainty and fear, the biblical call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring relief to the oppressed, give justice to the fatherless, plead the widow's cause' (Isaiah...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔洪水失踪亲人的消息中，人们对亲人安危的焦急等待，凸显了人类对联系的深切需求以及分离带来的痛苦。在如此充满不确定和恐惧的时刻，《圣经》中“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争辩”（以赛亚书 1:17）的呼吁，深刻地引起共鸣。它提醒我们要向那些承受如此深重损失和焦虑的人伸出同情和支持之手。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: BBC Inside Science
title.zh: BBC 科学内幕

summary.en: The proliferation of data centers, potentially numbering in the hundreds, raises questions about their varied and often unclear impacts, including carbon emissions, water usage, and power consumption. This report aims to clarify these issues with expert insights.
summary.zh: 数据中心正大量涌现，可能多达数百个。它们对碳排放、用水量和能源消耗等方面的各种影响，其真相往往难以辨别。本报道旨在通过专家见解来澄清这些问题。

body.en: Reports about the impacts of datacentres, including carbon emissions, water usage and power consumption, vary drastically and the truth can be hard to decipher. Deborah Andrews, Emeritus Professor at London South Bank University, joins us for some myth busting. Plus, science journalist Caroline Steel has been scouring the journals and brings us some of this week’s most exciting science news, including the failed attempts to save the Swift space telescope. Presenter: Tom Whipple Producers: Alex Mansfield, Katie Tomsett, Keiran Manetta-Jones Editor: Ilan Goodman Production Co-ordinator: Jana Bennett-Holesworth
body.zh: 关于数据中心的影响（包括碳排放、用水和电力消耗）的报告差异很大，真相可能很难解读。伦敦南岸大学名誉教授黛博拉·安德鲁斯 (Deborah Andrews) 与我们一起打破神话。此外，科学记者卡罗琳·斯蒂尔（Caroline Steel）一直在搜寻期刊，为我们带来了本周最令人兴奋的一些科学新闻，包括拯救斯威夫特太空望远镜的失败尝试。主持人：Tom Whipple 制片人：Alex Mansfield、Katie Tomsett、Keiran Manetta-Jones 编辑：Ilan Goodman 制作协调员：Jana Bennett-Holesworth

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers, as highlighted in this report, represents a surge in human knowledge and technological capability. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing and many running to and fro, a fitting image for our current era where understanding the complex consequences of such advancements, like those of data centers, becomes a pressing...
reflection.zh: 本报道中突出显示的数据中心快速增长，代表了人类知识和技术能力的激增。但以理书12:4预言“许多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长”，这恰当地描绘了我们这个时代，理解此类进步（如数据中心）的复杂后果，已成为一项紧迫的挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: West Point’s only climate scientist fired after continuing to teach human causes of climate change
title.zh: 西点军校唯一的气候科学家因继续教授人类导致气候变化而被解雇

summary.en: The sole climate scientist at West Point, Dr. Adam Kalkstein, was fired after allegedly refusing an order to stop teaching about the human causes of the climate emergency. A lawsuit claims his termination followed a disagreement with the academy's academic board dean.
summary.zh: 西点军校唯一的气候科学家亚当·卡尔克斯坦博士，在据称拒绝停止教授气候变化的人为原因后被解雇。一项诉讼声称，他的解雇是在与学院学术委员会院长发生分歧之后发生的。

body.en: Adam Kalkstein compared administration’s order to ‘trying to teach the law’ without mentioning ‘the constitution’ The only climate scientist teaching at West Point, the US army’s military academy, was fired after he resisted an order to stop teaching about the human causes of the climate emergency, a lawsuit claims. Dr Adam Kalkstein, a civilian professor of geography at the New York institution, was terminated after the spring semester this year, six months after a testy meeting with Brig Gen Shane Reeves, then dean of West Point’s academic board, the court filing said. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Dr. Adam Kalkstein's dismissal for teaching established climate science raises questions about academic freedom and the suppression of truth. When faced with directives that contradict observable reality and scientific consensus, the courage to uphold truth, even at personal cost, echoes the apostles' declaration: 'We must obey God rather than human...
reflection.zh: 亚当·卡尔克斯坦博士因教授既定的气候科学而被解雇，这引发了关于学术自由和真相被压制的疑问。当面临与可观察到的现实和科学共识相悖的指令时，即使付出个人代价也要坚持真理的勇气，呼应了使徒的宣告：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人。”这种情况促使我们思考，当机构的要求与基本真理发生冲突时，我们最终的忠诚何在。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

reflection.zh: 对日益强大的人工智能的不懈追求，以及容纳它们的庞大数据中心，让人想起古代巴别塔的故事。人类试图通过技术力量触及天堂，却不顾其对地球及其居民的影响，这引发了对我们终极目标和智慧的疑问。我们是在建造最终将分裂我们的高塔，还是在奠定服务于万物的根基？

title.en: AI searched 100 million possibilities and found a cheaper way to 3D-print a NASA rocket alloy
title.zh: 人工智能搜索了1亿种可能性，找到了3D打印NASA火箭合金的更便宜方法

summary.en: Researchers utilized AI to explore over 100 million potential settings for 3D printing a high-performance NASA alloy. Within just 40 experiments, the system identified six successful configurations, including one that operated at a record low of 500 watts, potentially enabling wider use of the alloy.
summary.zh: 研究人员利用人工智能搜索了超过1亿种3D打印高性能NASA合金的可能设置。仅进行了40次实验，该系统就确定了六种成功的配置，其中包括一种以创纪录的500瓦低功率运行的配置，这可能使该合金得到更广泛的应用。

body.en:
Washington State University researchers have used artificial intelligence to identify a faster and less costly way to 3D print a high-performance metal alloy, avoiding the need to manually test more than 100 million possible printing configurations.

The advance could eventually make the alloy, which is widely used in aerospace applications and may have uses in other industries, printable on more common commercial equipment. The AI strategy developed by the team could also be useful for other scientific problems involving enormous numbers of possible experiments, including drug discovery.

Researchers from WSU's School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science and the School of Mechanical and Materials Engineering published the work in the Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence . The project also received the Innovative Deployed Application Award at the organization's annual conference.

"Ninety percent of commercial printers cannot print this metal alloy, so given that we were able to find these feasible process parameters, it allows us to use those commercial printers, and we are essentially democratizing the printing of this alloy," said Jana Doppa, Huie-Rogers Endowed Chair Professor of Computer Science and Berry Distinguished Professor in Engineering who led the research.

The material, GRCop-42, is an alloy made from copper, chromium, and niobium. NASA developed it for demanding environments where both heat resistance and efficient heat transfer are essential.

Because GRCop-42 has high thermal conductivity while maintaining its strength at extreme temperatures, it is used in aerospace systems, including liquid rocket engine combustion chambers. Despite its desirable properties and broader potential, however, the alloy is difficult and costly to 3D print because the process typically requires substantial laser power and energy.

Previous attempts to print GRCop-42 using the lower wattages available on more common commercial machines had not succeeded. Testing possible printing settings one by one is also impractical. Each attempt consumes expensive material, requires specialized equipment, and takes considerable human effort. A single print can cost hundreds of dollars, and thoroughly analyzing the finished sample can require several days.

"Sometimes they printed a certain configuration, and the product just melted," said Azza Fadhel, first author of the paper and a PhD student in computer science. "It wasn't really printable, and even with time and money, they wouldn't be able to try all 100 million options. What we were doing in our collaboration is to apply the AI so that we efficiently choose candidates from this very large search space."

The researchers started with data from 37 printing configurations that...
body.zh: 华盛顿州立大学的研究人员利用人工智能找到了一种更快、成本更低的 3D 打印高性能金属合金的方法，从而无需手动测试超过 1 亿种可能的打印配置。 这一进展最终可能使这种广泛用于航空航天应用并可能用于其他行业的合金可以在更常见的商业设备上打印。该团队开发的人工智能策略也可用于解决涉及大量可能实验的其他科学问题，包括药物发现。 来自华盛顿州立大学电气工程与计算机科学学院以及机械与材料工程学院的研究人员在 AAAI 人工智能会议论文集上发表了这项工作。该项目还在该组织的年会上获得了创新部署应用程序奖。 “百分之九十的商业打印机无法打印这种金属合金，因此，鉴于我们能够找到这些可行的工艺参数，它允许我们使用这些商业打印机，并且我们基本上使这种合金的打印民主化，”领导这项研究的计算机科学教授兼贝里杰出工程教授 Jana Doppa 说。 该材料 GRCop-42 是一种由铜、铬和铌制成的合金。 NASA 为耐热性和高效传热都至关重要的苛刻环境开发了它。 由于 GRCop-42 具有高导热性，同时在极端温度下仍保持强度，因此用于航空航天系统，包括液体火箭发动机燃烧室。然而，尽管该合金具有理想的特性和更广泛的潜力，但它的 3D 打印难度很大且成本高昂，因为该过程通常需要大量的激光功率和能量。 之前尝试使用更常见的商用机器上可用的较低瓦数打印 GRCop-42 并未成功。一项一项地测试可能的打印设置也是不切实际的。每次尝试都消耗昂贵的材料，需要专门的设备，并且需要大量的人力。一次打印可能花费数百美元，彻底分析完成的样本可能需要几天的时间。 “有时他们打印出某种配置，然后产品就融化了，”该论文的第一作者、计算机科学博士生 Azza Fadhel 说。 “它并不是真正可打印的，即使有时间和金钱，他们也无法尝试所有 1 亿个选项。我们在合作中所做的是应用人工智能，以便我们从这个非常大的搜索空间中有效地选择候选人。” 研究人员从 37 种打印配置的数据开始，这些数据......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this research, reflects a broader trend of accelerating knowledge and technological capability. While this innovation promises efficiency and cost savings, it also calls us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding such powerful tools. May we pursue knowledge with humility and a deep...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，正如这项研究所示，反映了知识和技术能力加速的更广泛趋势。虽然这项创新有望提高效率和节省成本，但它也促使我们思考指导这些强大工具的智慧和伦理框架。愿我们以谦卑和对其潜在影响的深刻尊重来追求知识。

title.en: “I jumped from my chair” – Astronomers spot Betelgeuse’s hidden companion
title.zh: “我从椅子上跳了起来”——天文学家发现参宿四隐藏的伴星

summary.en: Astronomers have captured their clearest image yet of Betelgeuse’s long-suspected companion, potentially ending a search that lasted about 100 years. The surprisingly massive hidden star could help explain Betelgeuse’s changing brightness and may influence its future supernova.
summary.zh: 天文学家们捕捉到了迄今为止最清晰的、关于人们长期以来猜测的参宿四伴星的图像，这可能结束了长达约100年的搜寻。这颗出人意料地巨大的隐藏恒星可能有助于解释参宿四亮度的变化，并可能影响其未来的超新星爆发。

body.en:
Astronomers now have their strongest evidence yet that Betelgeuse, one of the best-known stars in the night sky, has a stellar companion. A team led by French astronomer Miguel Montargès used the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope (ESO's VLT) to capture the clearest image so far of what is believed to be Betelgeuse B, a star orbiting the famous red supergiant.

"We have shown that Betelgeuse is not single, it is accompanied by a faint stellar companion," says Montargès, astronomer at the Observatoire de Paris -- PSL, France, and lead author of the study published today in Astronomy & Astrophysics.

Betelgeuse -- a reddish star in the Orion constellation that is easily visible with the naked eye and is known to change in brightness -- has been watched by people for thousands of years. Even after centuries of scientific observation, however, the star continues to produce surprises.

"I jumped from my chair when I saw the processed images," recalls Montargès.

The possibility that Betelgeuse has a companion was first raised roughly a century ago as a potential explanation for some of its changes in brightness. Despite decades of observations, astronomers had been unable to clearly detect such a star.

That changed after Two studies published in 2024 made strong predictions about where the suspected companion should be. The studies indicated that Betelgeuse B would reach its greatest apparent separation from Betelgeuse in December 2024, giving astronomers their best opportunity to see it.

Montargès and his colleagues observed Betelgeuse with ESO's VLT that December. They then spent several months carefully processing and analyzing the observations.

"Honestly, I thought we did not have the sensitivity to detect Betelgeuse B as it was predicted," explains Montargès. "Because it is more massive than predicted, we see it!"

Scientists had initially estimated that the companion would have roughly the same mass as the Sun. The new observations instead suggest that Betelgeuse B is considerably larger, with about two to three times the Sun's mass.

"The fact that we can still discover a nearby companion, more massive and brighter than the Sun, around such a well-studied star is remarkable," says Montargès. "These are among the best moments in science: seeing something new, unexpected."

The researchers directly imaged Betelgeuse B, meaning they detected light coming from the companion itself. They accomplished this using the SPHERE instrument on ESO's VLT in Chile's Atacama Desert.

Previous observations had already provided clues that the companion existed, including a possible direct detection made with the Gemini North Telescope in Hawaiʻi, USA. The latest VLT observations, however, provide...
body.zh: 天文学家现在拥有迄今为止最有力的证据，证明夜空中最著名的恒星之一参宿四有一颗伴星。由法国天文学家 Miguel Montargès 领导的团队使用欧洲南方天文台的甚大望远镜（ESO 的 VLT）捕捉到了迄今为​​止最清晰的图像，据信是参宿四 B，这是一颗围绕着著名的红超巨星运行的恒星。 法国巴黎天文台的天文学家、今天发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的这项研究的主要作者蒙塔格斯说：“我们已经证明参宿四不是单一的，它还伴随着一颗微弱的恒星伴星。” 参宿四是猎户座中一颗微红色的恒星，肉眼很容易看到，并且亮度会发生变化，数千年来一直被人们所关注。然而，即使经过几个世纪的科学观察，这颗恒星仍然继续带来惊喜。 “当我看到处理后的图像时，我从椅子上跳了起来，”蒙塔格斯回忆道。 大约一个世纪前，参宿四有一个伴星的可能性首次被提出，作为其亮度变化的潜在解释。尽管进行了数十年的观测，天文学家仍无法清楚地探测到这样一颗恒星。 2024 年发表的两项研究对疑似同伴应该在哪里做出了强有力的预测后，情况发生了变化。研究表明，参宿四 B 将于 2024 年 12 月达到与参宿四的最大明显分离，这为天文学家提供了观测它的最佳机会。 那年 12 月，蒙塔格斯和他的同事用 ESO 的 VLT 观测了参宿四。然后他们花了几个月的时间仔细处理和分析观察结果。 “老实说，我认为我们没有像预测的那样具有检测参宿四 B 的灵敏度，”蒙塔吉斯解释道。 “因为它比预计的要大，所以我们看到了！” 科学家最初估计该伴星的质量与太阳大致相同。相反，新的观测表明参宿四 B 的质量要大得多，大约是太阳质量的两到三倍。 蒙塔格斯说：“我们仍然可以在这样一颗经过充分研究的恒星周围发现一个比太阳更大、更亮的伴星，这一事实是值得注意的。” “这是科学界最美好的时刻之一：看到一些新的、意想不到的东西。” 研究人员直接对参宿四 B 进行了成像，这意味着他们检测到了来自参宿四本身的光。他们使用位于智利阿塔卡马沙漠的 ESO VLT 上的 SPHERE 仪器完成了这一任务。 之前的观测已经提供了该伴星存在的线索，包括美国夏威夷双子座北望远镜可能进行的直接探测。然而，最新的 VLT 观测结果提供了……

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the vastness of the universe continues to reveal wonders beyond our immediate grasp. This discovery of a hidden star near Betelgeuse, after a century of searching, reminds us that even familiar celestial bodies hold profound mysteries. It invites awe and contemplation of the intricate design woven into the fabric...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，宇宙的浩瀚不断揭示着超越我们直接理解的奇迹。经过一个世纪的搜寻，在参宿四附近发现一颗隐藏的恒星，这提醒我们，即使是熟悉的星体也蕴藏着深刻的奥秘。它邀请我们怀着敬畏之心，去沉思那编织在宇宙结构中的精巧设计。

verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Your dislike of eating bugs may be 9,000 years old
title.zh: 您对吃虫子的厌恶可能已有9000年的历史

summary.en: Ancient teeth and human DNA are revealing a surprising history of insect eating. Modern humans in northern Eurasia appear to have eaten insects only occasionally, while Neanderthals may have consumed them much more regularly. Populations near the tropics also retained genes that...
summary.zh: 古代牙齿和人类DNA揭示了令人惊讶的昆虫食用历史。北欧亚的现代人类似乎只偶尔食用昆虫，而尼安德特人可能食用得更规律。靠近热带地区的人群也保留了基因，这些基因...

body.en:
As the global population grows and climate change places increasing pressure on food systems, researchers and policymakers are looking more closely at alternative sources of nutrition. Insects are one possible option. A total of 1,611 insect species are classified as edible, and organizations including the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have highlighted insects as a potentially sustainable food source.

Even so, many Western societies remain strongly resistant to entomophagy, or eating insects, despite the fact that hundreds of millions of people around the world already include insects in their diets. Culture may help explain that reluctance, but scientists have not known how far back it goes or what other forces may have shaped it.

Researchers from the Institute of Evolutionary Biology (IBE), a joint center of the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) and Pompeu Fabra University (UPF), have now used genomic evidence to reconstruct patterns of insect consumption stretching back thousands of years. Their findings, published in Science Advances , indicate that eating insects was probably occasional and accidental in Europe, Central and East Asia, while it appears to have been more common in tropical regions and among Neanderthals. The work offers new insights into human evolution, ecology, and modern attitudes toward insect-based foods.

To search for direct signs of insect consumption, the IBE researchers examined 745 samples of dental calculus (tartar) from anatomically modern humans dating back as far as 33,000 years. Dental tartar can trap and preserve DNA from species that were regularly eaten, providing researchers with a record of ancient diets.

The results suggest that modern humans living in northern Eurasia did not regularly eat insects. The team also examined genes involved in breaking down chitin, a major component of insect exoskeletons. Among North Eurasian populations, chitinase genes contain mutations associated with a reduced ability to digest insect exoskeletons. That genetic pattern has persisted for roughly 9,000 years, dating back to the rise of agriculture.

"The scarce presence of insects in the diet of northern Eurasians suggests that the absence of entomophagy is not solely due to recent cultural factors, but also to a long ecological and evolutionary history," says Pablo Librado, principal investigator at the IBE who led the study.

The picture was different for Neanderthals. Although they lived in many of the same environments as anatomically modern humans, their dental calculus contained considerably more insect DNA.

The amount detected in Neanderthal samples was similar to levels found in western chimpanzees, which use insects to supplement their diets on the savanna, particularly...
body.zh: 随着全球人口增长和气候变化给粮食系统带来越来越大的压力，研究人员和政策制定者正在更加密切地寻找替代营养来源。昆虫是一种可能的选择。共有 1,611 种昆虫被列为可食用昆虫，包括联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 在内的组织都强调昆虫是潜在的可持续食物来源。 即便如此，许多西方社会仍然强烈抵制食虫行为，尽管世界各地数亿人已经将昆虫纳入他们的饮食中。文化可能有助于解释这种不情愿，但科学家们还不知道它可以追溯到多久以前，也不知道是什么其他力量可能塑造了它。 西班牙国家研究委员会 (CSIC) 和庞培法布拉大学 (UPF) 联合中心进化生物学研究所 (IBE) 的研究人员现在利用基因组证据重建了数千年前的昆虫消费模式。他们发表在《科学进展》上的研究结果表明，在欧洲、中亚和东亚，吃昆虫可能是偶然和偶然的，而在热带地区和尼安德特人中，吃昆虫似乎更为常见。这项工作为人类进化、生态学和现代人对昆虫食品的态度提供了新的见解。 为了寻找昆虫食用的直接迹象，IBE 研究人员检查了 745 份来自解剖学上现代人类的牙结石（牙垢）样本，其历史可追溯到 33,000 年前。牙垢可以捕获并保存经常食用的物种的 DNA，为研究人员提供古代饮食记录。 结果表明，生活在欧亚大陆北部的现代人类并不经常吃昆虫。研究小组还检查了参与分解甲壳素（昆虫外骨骼的主要成分）的基因。在北欧亚种群中，几丁质酶基因含有与消化昆虫外骨骼能力降低相关的突变。这种遗传模式已经持续了大约 9000 年，可以追溯到农业兴起时。 领导这项研究的 IBE 首席研究员巴勃罗·利布拉多 (Pablo Librado) 表示：“欧亚大陆北部人的饮食中昆虫很少，这表明食虫行为的缺失不仅是由于最近的文化因素，而且还与悠久的生态和进化历史有关。” 对于尼安德特人来说，情况有所不同。尽管他们生活在许多与现代人类相同的环境中，但他们的牙结石含有更多的昆虫 DNA。 在尼安德特人样本中检测到的含量与在西方黑猩猩中发现的含量相似，西方黑猩猩在稀树草原上使用昆虫来补充饮食，特别是......

It reminds us that wisdom and knowledge about sustenance can be found by observing creation, as Job noted, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the...
reflection.zh: 对古代人类饮食的研究，包括食用昆虫，为了解我们的过去以及祖先与自然界互动的方式提供了迷人的视角。它提醒我们，正如约伯所指出的，“但你且问走兽，可也教你；飞鸟何可，亦必告诉你。” 智慧和营养知识可以在观察造物中找到。...
