verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Near total lunar eclipse will be seen from North and South America Thursday night
title.zh: 周四晚间北美和南美将可见近乎全食的月食

summary.en: Earth’s shadow will appear as a reddish ‘blood moon’ due to atmospheric light scattering. A near-total lunar eclipse will be visible across much of North and South America on Thursday night, with millions expected to witness this celestial event.
summary.zh: 由于大气散射阳光，地球的阴影将呈现出红色的“血月”。周四晚间，北美和南美大部分地区将可见近乎全食的月食，预计数百万人将目睹这一天象奇观。

body.en: Earth’s shadow will appear to be a reddish ‘blood moon’ due to the way sunlight is scattered by the atmosphere A near total lunar eclipse will be visible across large swathes of North and South America on Thursday night with millions of people expected to be able to see one of nature’s marvels. Lunar eclipses occur when Earth moves between the sun and the moon and its shadow is cast on to the lunar surface. In Thursday night’s event 96% of the moon will be darkened by the Earth’s shadow at its peak moment. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于阳光被大气层散射的方式，地球的阴影将呈现出微红色的“血月”。周四晚上，北美和南美大片地区将出现近乎月全食的景象，预计数百万人将能够看到这一自然奇观。当地球在太阳和月球之间移动并将其阴影投射到月球表面时，就会发生月食。在周四晚上的活动中，96% 的月球将在其高峰时刻被地球的阴影变暗。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Earth’s shadow paints the moon a deep red, we are reminded of the vastness and beauty of the cosmos. The Psalmist declares that the heavens themselves are a testament to Yahweh’s glory, a truth visible even in the shadowed face of the moon.
reflection.zh: 当地球的阴影将月亮染成深红色时，我们被提醒宇宙的浩瀚与美丽。诗人宣告诸天都在述说雅伟的荣耀，这真理甚至在月亮被遮蔽的脸上也能看见。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: A mysterious cosmic hum may come from 13-billion-year-old dark stars
title.zh: 神秘的宇宙嗡嗡声可能来自130亿年前的暗星

summary.en: A faint background of extremely low-frequency gravitational waves, detected through pulsar networks, may hold clues to events over 13 billion years ago, including the formation of the universe's first supermassive black holes. Researchers are investigating if these early black holes could contribute significantly to...
summary.zh: 通过脉冲星网络探测到的极低频引力波的微弱背景，可能包含130多亿年前事件的线索，包括宇宙最早的超大质量黑洞的出现。研究人员正在调查这些早期黑洞是否可能对当前测量的引力波背景做出重大贡献。

body.en:
A faint background of extremely low frequency gravitational waves detected through networks of pulsars could contain clues to events that unfolded more than 13 billion years ago, including the emergence of some of the Universe's earliest supermassive black holes.

In a study published as a Letter in Physical Review D , Colgate University researchers Sohan Ghodla and Cosmin Ilie examined whether supermassive black holes that originated in the early Universe could eventually produce a significant share of the gravitational wave background now being measured by Pulsar Timing Arrays, or PTAs.

The findings connect two areas of astronomy that may at first seem far apart. One involves observations of surprisingly massive black holes that already existed when the Universe was young. The other involves gravitational waves generated billions of years later by pairs of supermassive black holes spiraling toward one another.

The researchers found that one possible class of early black hole seeds, remnants left behind by supermassive Dark Stars, could potentially provide a dominant contribution to the PTA signal.

"Pulsar timing arrays are usually thought of as probes of supermassive black-hole binaries in the relatively recent Universe," said Ilie. "What our work shows is that the signal may also contain information about how the ancestors of those black holes formed at cosmic dawn. In that sense, gravitational waves observed today could provide a new window onto the birth of the first supermassive black holes."

Pulsar Timing Arrays rely on rapidly spinning neutron stars known as pulsars, which act as extraordinarily precise clocks in space. When gravitational waves pass through the cosmos, they cause tiny changes in the timing of the radio pulses that eventually arrive at Earth. By tracking many pulsars over long periods, international research teams have found evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background at nanohertz frequencies.

The most widely accepted astrophysical explanation for this background is a population of supermassive black hole binaries gradually spiraling inward. Systems whose black holes have a combined mass greater than roughly a billion Suns make especially important contributions at the frequencies detected by PTAs.

But explaining those enormous black holes raises a deeper question. Astronomers still want to know how their original seeds formed. Observatories including the James Webb Space Telescope and Chandra have discovered massive black holes at unexpectedly early stages of cosmic history, increasing interest in formation mechanisms capable of producing large black hole seeds very quickly.

Ghodla and Ilie investigated whether the descendants of such ancient seeds could persist through cosmic time, grow alongside their...
body.zh: 通过脉冲星网络检测到的极低频引力波的微弱背景可能包含超过 130 亿年前发生的事件的线索，包括宇宙中一些最早的超大质量黑洞的出现。 在《物理评论 D》上发表的一项研究中，科尔盖特大学研究人员 Sohan Ghodla 和 Cosmin Ilie 研究了起源于早期宇宙的超大质量黑洞最终是否会产生目前由脉冲星定时阵列（PTA）测量的引力波背景的很大一部分。 这些发现将乍一看似乎相距甚远的两个天文学领域联系在一起。其中一项涉及对宇宙年轻时就已经存在的巨大黑洞的观测。另一种涉及数十亿年后由成对的超大质量黑洞相互螺旋运动产生的引力波。 研究人员发现，一类可能的早期黑洞种子，即超大质量暗星留下的残余物，可能对 PTA 信号产生主要贡献。 “脉冲星计时阵列通常被认为是相对较新的宇宙中超大质量黑洞双星的探测器，”伊利说。 “我们的工作表明，该信号还可能包含有关这些黑洞的祖先如何在宇宙黎明时形成的信息。从这个意义上说，今天观测到的引力波可以为了解第一个超大质量黑洞的诞生提供一个新的窗口。” 脉冲星计时阵列依赖于快速旋转的中子星（称为脉冲星），脉冲星在太空中充当极其精确的时钟。当引力波穿过宇宙时，它们会导致最终到达地球的无线电脉冲的时间发生微小变化。通过长期跟踪许多脉冲星，国际研究小组发现了纳赫频率随机引力波背景的证据。 对于这种背景，最广泛接受的天体物理学解释是一群超大质量黑洞双星逐渐向内盘旋。黑洞总质量超过大约 10 亿个太阳的系统在 PTA 检测到的频率上做出了特别重要的贡献。 但解释这些巨大的黑洞引发了一个更深层次的问题。天文学家仍然想知道它们最初的种子是如何形成的。包括詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和钱德拉在内的天文台在宇宙历史的早期阶段意外地发现了巨大的黑洞，这增加了人们对能够快速产生大型黑洞种子的形成机制的兴趣。 戈德拉和伊利研究了这种古老种子的后代是否能够在宇宙时间中持续存在，与它们一起生长……

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the faint whispers of gravitational waves reaching us across billions of years invite awe. This scientific endeavor to understand the universe's origins, from hypothetical Dark Stars to the first black holes, echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself speaks of its Maker's power and design. As we probe these cosmic...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚以及跨越数十亿年传来的微弱引力波，引人深思。这项旨在理解宇宙起源的科学探索，从假想的暗星到最早的黑洞，呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身就诉说着造物主的权能与设计。当我们探究这些宇宙奥秘时，我们被提醒，雅伟的手在万有之中，无论可见或不可见。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Black Box: The Chatbots: a new series from The Guardian Investigates – trailer
title.zh: 黑匣子：聊天机器人：卫报调查新系列——预告片

summary.en: People are becoming convinced AI chatbots have helped them make scientific breakthroughs, cure diseases or invent new technologies. What does this reveal about a technology used by more than a billion people? A new series from The Guardian Investigates, coming soon.
summary.zh: 人们越来越相信人工智能聊天机器人帮助他们取得了科学突破、治愈了疾病或发明了新技术。这揭示了这项被超过十亿人使用的技术是怎样的？《卫报》调查新系列即将推出。

body.en: People are becoming convinced AI chatbots have helped them make scientific breakthroughs, cure diseases or invent new technologies. What does this reveal about a technology used by more than a billion people? A new series from The Guardian Investigates, coming soon
body.zh: 人们越来越相信人工智能聊天机器人已经帮助他们取得了科学突破、治愈疾病或发明新技术。对于超过十亿人使用的技术，这揭示了什么？ 《卫报调查》的新系列即将推出

reflection.en: The rapid advancement and widespread adoption of AI chatbots, as suggested by this news, echo the ancient prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. As we marvel at these new tools, we are reminded of the accelerating pace of human discovery and the profound implications for our world.
reflection.zh: 正如这则新闻所暗示的，人工智能聊天机器人的快速发展和广泛应用，呼应了古代关于知识增长的预言。当我们惊叹于这些新工具时，我们被提醒人类发现的步伐正在加快，以及这对我们的世界产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Michael Sheen hopes 'extraordinary' reaction to toxic waste documentary spurs action
title.zh: 迈克尔·辛希望“非凡”的毒品废料纪录片反应能促进行动

summary.en: Dozens of people contacted BBC Wales following coverage of Sheen's investigation into chemical giant Monsanto.
summary.zh: 在辛的调查报道了化学巨头孟山都公司后，数十人联系了BBC威尔士。

body.en:
Michael Sheen has welcomed the reaction to his documentary investigating Wales' toxic waste legacy, saying he hopes it pushes the relevant authorities to "find a solution".

Dozens of people contacted BBC Wales following coverage of Sheen's investigation into chemical giant Monsanto and the dumping of polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs).

One of them was a former Monsanto worker who spent three years helping to seal toxic waste underground and said staff had "cheap" protective equipment and were not told what they were burying.

Eastman Chemical Company, which is responsible for Monsanto's legacy production in the UK, did not respond to either Sheen and his team or the BBC when asked to comment.

Asked about the response to the documentary, Sheen said he wanted "to see something actually happen".

"So getting a response was a really important part of it, and hoping that response would push the people who are in positions to get on with it," he said.

Sheen said he had received "extraordinary messages" from people who wanted to tell their stories and how they had been affected.

Sheen said he hoped "people in the more official areas" would respond as well and "work with us on it".

"We want to find a solution rather than something that keeps putting people in a position where they have to put breaks on because they can't afford to get involved in this, so we really want to find a solution to this."

What is the truth lying beneath our feet? Michael Sheen uncovers claims of conspiracy, complicity and denial over alleged toxic 'forever chemical' contamination in south Wales.

Much of the documentary focuses on researcher and whistleblower Douglas Gowan, who tried to raise the alarm about 14 sites - 12 of which were in Wales - but died before his warnings were heeded.

"What he told me made my blood run cold," said Sheen, who spoke to Gowan months before he died.

Gowan, a former farming consultant, alleged that chemical giant Monsanto had dumped "huge amounts of industrial chemicals all around Wales".

Following coverage of the documentary, people contacted BBC Wales to speak about their experience, including Stephen Constance, 61, who worked at Monsanto's Newport factory in the 1990s.

Natural Resources Wales previously said "the legacy of historic industrial activity" in the UK and globally was an issue, most of which "took place before modern environmental regulations were in place", the "records can be limited and the nature of waste is not always fully known".

The Welsh government previously said that "addressing contaminated land" was a key priority.
body.zh: 迈克尔·辛（Michael Sheen）对他的纪录片调查威尔士有毒废物遗留问题的反应表示欢迎，并表示他希望这能推动有关当局“找到解决方案”。 在报道辛对化学巨头孟山都公司和倾倒多氯联苯（PCB）的调查后，数十人联系了 BBC Wales。 其中一位是孟山都公司的前员工，他花了三年时间帮助将有毒废物封入地下，并表示工作人员拥有“廉价”的防护设备，并且不知道他们在埋什么。 当被要求置评时，负责孟山都在英国传统生产的伊士曼化学公司没有回应希恩和他的团队或英国广播公司的评论。 当被问及对这部纪录片的反应时，辛说他希望“看到一些真正发生的事情”。 “因此，得到回应是其中非常重要的一部分，并希望这种回应能够推动有能力的人继续努力，”他说。 辛说，他收到了来自人们的“非同寻常的信息”，他们想要讲述自己的故事以及他们如何受到影响。 辛表示，他希望“官方领域的人们”也能做出回应并“与我们合作”。 “我们希望找到一个解决方案，而不是让人们因为无力参与其中而不得不休息的情况，所以我们真的想找到一个解决方案。” 我们脚下的真相是什么？迈克尔·辛 (Michael Sheen) 揭露了有关南威尔士有毒“永久化学”污染事件的阴谋、共谋和否认的指控。 这部纪录片的大部分内容聚焦于研究人员兼举报人道格拉斯·高恩 (Douglas Gowan)，他试图对 14 个地点（其中 12 个位于威尔士）发出警报，但在他的警告得到重视之前就去世了。 “他告诉我的话让我浑身发冷，”辛说，他在高恩去世前几个月与他交谈过。 前农业顾问高恩声称，化学巨头孟山都公司在“威尔士各地倾倒了大量工业化学品”。 这部纪录片报道后，人们联系了 BBC Wales 讲述他们的经历，其中包括 61 岁的史蒂芬·康斯坦斯 (Stephen Constance)，他于 20 世纪 90 年代在孟山都的纽波特工厂工作。 威尔士自然资源部此前表示，在英国和全球范围内，“历史性工业活动的遗产”是一个问题，其中大部分“发生在现代环境法规到位之前”，“记录可能有限，而且废物的性质并不总是完全清楚”。 威尔士政府此前表示，“解决土地污染问题”是首要任务。

reflection.en: Michael Sheen's documentary has brought to light the experiences of those affected by toxic waste, including a former worker who lacked proper protection and information. This echoes the call in Proverbs 31:8 to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all who are weak and vulnerable." The story prompts us to consider our responsibility to...
reflection.zh: 迈克尔·辛的纪录片揭露了受有毒废物影响者的经历，其中包括一位缺乏适当保护和信息的蒙山都前工人。这呼应了箴言31:8的呼吁：“你们要为不能言语的，为一切遭殃的，伸明情理。”这个故事促使我们反思自己为那些健康和安全受到损害的人们发声的责任，尤其是在强大的实体可能辜负了他们的时候。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Scientists switch on a strange new form of magnetism in an ultrathin material
title.zh: 科学家在超薄材料中开启一种奇特的磁性新形式

summary.en: Scientists have discovered a novel way to potentially activate an unusual type of magnetism in ruthenium dioxide, a material typically considered nonmagnetic. When this material was fashioned into an ultrathin film, just a few atomic layers thick, and subjected to strain, its electrons exhibited patterns indicative of...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一种潜在的、激活二氧化钌中一种不寻常磁性的新颖方法，而二氧化钌通常被认为是非磁性的。当这种材料被制成仅有几个原子层厚的超薄薄膜并承受应变时，其电子表现出与altermagnetism一致的模式，这是一种最近提出的磁态，在先进电子学中具有潜在应用。

body.en: Scientists have found a surprising way to potentially switch on an unusual form of magnetism in ruthenium dioxide, a material that normally appears nonmagnetic. When the material was made into an ultrathin film only a few atomic layers thick and placed under strain, its electrons developed patterns consistent with altermagnetism, a recently proposed magnetic state with promising uses in advanced electronics.
body.zh: 科学家们发现了一种令人惊讶的方法，可以在二氧化钌中开启一种不寻常的磁性，这种材料通常看起来是非磁性的。当这种材料被制成只有几个原子层厚的超薄膜并置于应变下时，其电子会形成与交变磁性一致的图案，这是最近提出的一种磁性状态，在先进电子学中具有广阔的应用前景。

reflection.en: The intricate dance of electrons within an ultrathin film, revealing a new form of magnetism, speaks to the profound order Yahweh has woven into the fabric of creation. Job reminds us that even the natural world, from the smallest material to the grandest celestial body, testifies to His wisdom and power. May we approach such discoveries with humility and...
reflection.zh: 电子在超薄薄膜中错综复杂的舞动，揭示了一种新的磁性形式，这说明了雅伟编织进创造的结构中的深刻秩序。约伯提醒我们，即使是自然界，从最小的物质到最宏伟的天体，都见证祂的智慧和力量。愿我们以谦卑和敬畏之心来对待这些发现，认识到它们是瞥见创造主精湛设计的窗口。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How decoding beluga whales’ chitchat may save them – and teach us more about ourselves
title.zh: 解码白鲸的“闲聊”如何拯救它们——并教给我们更多关于我们自己的知识

summary.en: From humpbacks learning the latest songs to sperm whales’ ‘clan codas’, drones and AI learning are helping reveal another dimension to the concept of culture In 2015, the whale researcher Valeria Vergara pitched a small tent at the icy water’s edge on Somerset Island in the remote Canadian high Arctic, shrouded in a...
summary.zh: 从座头鲸学习最新歌曲到抹香鲸的“家族密码”，无人机和人工智能学习正在帮助揭示文化概念的另一个维度。2015年，鲸鱼研究员瓦莱里娅·维加拉在加拿大遥远的北极高地萨默塞特岛冰冷的水边搭起了一个小帐篷，周围被浓雾笼罩，她甚至看不清自己的手。她将一根绳子拖到海岸边，将一个水听器放入水中，记录白鲸的叫声。多达1000头白鲸，伴随...

body.en: From humpbacks learning the latest songs to sperm whales’ ‘clan codas’, drones and AI learning are helping reveal another dimension to the concept of culture In 2015, the whale researcher Valeria Vergara pitched a small tent at the icy water’s edge on Somerset Island in the remote Canadian high Arctic, shrouded in a freezing fog so thick she struggled to see her own hands. She trailed a cord out to the coast and plopped a hydrophone into the water to record the calls of belugas. As many as 1,000 of the whales, accompanied by their newborn calves, frequented the surrounding bay. Belugas’ ceaseless chatter, made up of dozens of unique sounds, is crucial to keeping these creatures connected in the dim, turbid waters of the Arctic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从座头鲸学习最新的歌曲到抹香鲸的“氏族尾声”，无人机和人工智能学习正在帮助揭示文化概念的另一个维度。2015年，鲸鱼研究员瓦莱里娅·维加拉(Valeria Vergara)在加拿大偏远北极地区萨默塞特岛的冰冷水边搭起了一个小帐篷，周围笼罩着一层厚厚的冰雾，她几乎看不到自己的双手。她拖着一根绳子到海岸，将水听器扔进水中记录白鲸的叫声。多达 1000 头鲸鱼带着新生的小鲸鱼经常出没于周围的海湾。白鲸不断的叽叽喳喳声由数十种独特的声音组成，对于保持这些生物在北极昏暗浑浊的水域中的联系至关重要。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The diligent work of researchers like Valeria Vergara, who set up a tent on Somerset Island to record beluga whale calls, beautifully illustrates the human drive to uncover the mysteries of creation. Using drones and AI to decode the belugas' 'ceaseless chatter' is a modern expression of the 'glory of kings' to search out what Yahweh has hidden. This...
reflection.zh: 研究人员如瓦莱里娅·维加拉在萨默塞特岛搭帐篷记录白鲸叫声的勤奋工作，生动地展现了人类探索创造奥秘的动力。利用无人机和人工智能解码白鲸“不停的闲聊”，是“君王的荣耀”去探究雅伟所隐藏之事的现代体现。这种科学探索不仅帮助我们理解这些复杂的生物，也加深了我们对自然界中蕴含的精妙智慧的欣赏。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: A solution to the mystery of the missing neutrinos
title.zh: 缺失中微子之谜的解决方案

summary.en: Preparations for a lecture prompt a scientist to re-examine and ultimately resolve the 'gallium anomaly,' a long-standing puzzle in particle physics concerning the behavior of neutrinos.
summary.zh: 为准备讲座，一位科学家重新审视并最终解决了粒子物理学中关于中微子行为的长期存在的“镓异常”之谜。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, even in the most complex scientific mysteries like the behavior of neutrinos, is a testament to human curiosity and God-given intellect. As Daniel foretold, in the end times, knowledge and understanding will increase, and this story is a small example of that unfolding.
reflection.zh: 追求知识，即使是像中微子行为这样复杂的科学谜团，也证明了人类的好奇心和上帝所赐的智慧。正如但以理所预言的，在末世，知识和悟性必增多，这个故事正是这一预言的体现。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Animal-microbe partnerships date back to the dawn of complex life
title.zh: 动物与微生物的伙伴关系可追溯到复杂生命的黎明

summary.en: Researchers have found geochemical clues suggesting that worm-like creatures during the Ediacaran period engaged in symbiotic relationships with bacteria, indicating these partnerships are fundamental to complex life's early history.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现了地球化学线索，表明埃迪卡拉纪的蠕虫状生物与细菌存在共生关系，这暗示着此类伙伴关系是复杂生命早期历史的基础。

reflection.en: This discovery, revealing ancient worm-like creatures in the Ediacaran period thriving through symbiosis with bacteria, offers a glimpse into the profound interconnectedness of life from its earliest complex forms. It reminds us of the countless, often hidden, ways Yahweh has intricately designed the earth to be full of His creatures, all made in wisdom.
reflection.zh: 这项发现揭示了埃迪卡拉纪的古老蠕虫状生物通过与细菌共生而繁衍，让我们得以一窥生命从最早的复杂形式开始就存在的深刻互联。它提醒我们，雅伟以何等奇妙的智慧创造了地球，使其充满祂的万物，一切都彰显着祂的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Robot Olympics’ reveal humanoids' rapid progress — but hurdles remain
title.zh: “机器人奥运会”揭示类人机器人的飞速进步——但障碍依然存在

summary.en: Humanoid robots achieved record-breaking speeds in athletic events like sprints during a recent competition, yet they continued to struggle with basic practical skills such as hammering nails.
summary.zh: 在最近的一场竞技活动中，类人机器人在短跑等体育项目中打破了记录，但在钉钉子等基础实用技能方面仍然表现挣扎。

reflection.en: While we marvel at the rapid acceleration of robotic speed and power, the 'Robot Olympics' reminds us of the profound sophistication of the human form. A robot may outrun a sprinter, yet it falters at the delicate coordination required to drive a simple nail. This gap invites us to appreciate the intricate design Yahweh has woven into our very bodies,...
reflection.zh: 当我们惊叹于机器人速度与力量的飞速提升时，“机器人奥运会”也提醒着我们人类形态那深不可测的复杂性。机器人或许能在短跑中超越人类，但在钉钉子所需的细腻协调面前却显得笨拙。这种差距邀请我们去赞美雅伟在我们的身体中所编织的奇妙设计，这种设计将力量与多才多艺的智慧结合在一起，而这正是技术至今仍在努力模仿的。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Glacier collapse caused Nepal’s deadly flash flood — a sign of things to come?
title.zh: 冰川崩塌引发尼泊尔洪水——预示着未来？

summary.en: Global warming is destabilizing high-altitude regions, potentially leading to more frequent landslides and floods.
summary.zh: 全球变暖正在破坏高海拔地区的稳定性，可能导致更频繁的山体滑坡和洪水。

reflection.en: The news from Nepal, where a glacier collapse triggered a devastating flood, illustrates the profound distress of our planet. The Bible speaks of all creation groaning under the weight of sin and decay, awaiting redemption. This event serves as a somber reminder of our interconnectedness with the natural world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔因冰川崩塌引发毁灭性洪水的消息，生动地展现了我们星球深重的痛苦。圣经提到，万物都一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着被救赎。这一事件令人警醒地提醒我们与自然界的相互依存关系，以及我们照管受造界的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Women face bans on research underground — here’s how to modernize the system
title.zh: 女性在地下研究中面临禁令——如何使系统现代化

summary.en: Nature reports that female engineers in many countries are barred from entering deep mines for research. Experts suggest that differentiating risks rather than blanket bans can increase access while maintaining safety standards.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志报道称，许多国家的女性工程师被禁止进入深层矿井进行研究。专家建议，通过区分风险而非一味禁止，可以在保持安全标准的同时增加女性的参与机会。

reflection.en: The exclusion of women from deep-mine research reflects outdated systems that overlook individual capability in favor of rigid categories. When we recognize that every person carries the same inherent dignity, we are moved to create professional environments that are both safe and inclusive. Modernizing these systems is not just about efficiency, but about...
reflection.zh: 将女性排除在深矿研究之外，反映了那些忽视个人能力而固守僵化分类的陈旧体系。当我们意识到每个人都拥有相同的内在尊严时，我们就会努力创造既安全又包容的专业环境。使这些系统现代化不仅是为了效率，更是为了尊重雅伟赋予所有人的多样才华。

verse.textEn: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse.textZh: 并不分犹太人、希利尼人，自主的、为奴的，或男或女，因为你们在基督耶稣里都成为一了。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: The iconic T-38 jets flown by astronauts just got a spiffy new look
title.zh: 宇航员驾驶的标志性T-38喷气式飞机焕然一新

summary.en: NASA has unveiled a new 'Artemis' livery for one of its iconic T-38 astronaut training jets, marking the first design change in decades. The new black, white, blue, and red paint scheme celebrates the agency's program to return astronauts to the Moon.
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）为其标志性的T-38宇航员训练机之一推出了全新的“阿尔忒弥斯”涂装，这是几十年来首次进行设计更改。新的黑白蓝红配色方案旨在庆祝该机构将宇航员送回月球的计划。

body.en: For the first time in decades, NASA has rolled out one of its iconic astronaut training aircraft with a bold, new look. The space agency debuted a new livery on one of its T-38 jets in celebration of its program to return astronauts to the Moon. The Artemis design retains nods to what made the "white rocket" immediately recognizable, but adds a new colorway and painted graphics to make clear where NASA is headed. "This new 'Artemis' livery has a black and white paint scheme with blue and red stripes that separate those two paint schemes," said Sean Brady, who proposed and designed the new livery while serving as the T-38 project pilot in NASA's Aircraft Operations Division (AOD), part of the Flight Operations Directorate at Johnson Space Center in Houston. "The Artemis program logo in the back and a picture of the Moon is on the left and right side of the rear fuselage." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 几十年来，美国宇航局首次推出了一款具有大胆新外观的标志性宇航员训练机。该航天局在其一架 T-38 喷气式飞机上首次推出了新涂装，以庆祝其将宇航员送回月球的计划。阿耳忒弥斯的设计保留了对“白色火箭”的辨识度的致敬，但增加了新的配色和彩绘图案，以明确 NASA 的发展方向。肖恩·布雷迪 (Sean Brady) 表示：“这款新的‘阿耳忒弥斯’涂装采用黑白涂装方案，其中蓝色和红色条纹将这两种涂装方案分开。”肖恩·布雷迪 (Sean Brady) 在担任 NASA 飞机操作部 (AOD) 的 T-38 项目飞行员期间提出并设计了新涂装，该部门是休斯顿约翰逊航天中心飞行操作局的一部分。 “背面有阿耳忒弥斯计划标志，后机身左右两侧有月球图片。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: NASA's new livery on its T-38 jets, celebrating the Artemis program's goal to return astronauts to the Moon, embodies humanity's enduring drive to explore. This quest to 'search out a matter' in the cosmos reflects a deep-seated human curiosity and the dignity of discovery. As we look to the Moon and beyond, we participate in the ongoing revelation of...
reflection.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的T-38教练机换上新涂装，庆祝阿尔忒弥斯计划重返月球，这体现了人类探索的持久动力。这种在宇宙中“查明事情”的追求，反映了人类深层的好奇心和发现的尊严。当我们展望月球及更远之处时，我们参与了创造奇迹的持续启示。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Google, Microsoft and OpenAI among 100 firms calling for better cyber defences
title.zh: 谷歌、微软和OpenAI等百家公司呼吁加强网络防御

summary.en: A group of 100 technology and financial firms, including Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, have issued an open letter urging countries and organizations to enhance their cyber defenses. They warn that AI-powered cyber-attacks will become more widespread and sophisticated within months, criticizing the current...
summary.zh: 包括谷歌、微软和OpenAI在内的100家科技和金融公司发表了一封公开信，敦促各国和组织加强网络防御。他们警告说，人工智能驱动的网络攻击将在数月内变得更加普遍和复杂，并批评目前关键基础设施安全资源投入不足。

body.en:
A group of 100 firms, including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, have signed an open letter calling on countries and organisations around the world to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

The letter warns , external cyber-attacks which use AI will become both more widespread and more sophisticated in a matter of months as the technology rapidly improves.

The group says current "status quo" security measures "won't be enough" and criticises the "historic under-resourcing" of security around critical infrastructure.

Other firms to have signed the letter include banks such as Capital One, payment processors MasterCard and Visa, and other major tech firms including Adobe, Oracle and IBM.

They call on governments to provide "capable, defensive AI" and testing to hospitals and water utilities.

But it is also true that many of the most powerful AI have been developed by some of these companies - and they are not all easily available.

Mythos, developed by Anthropic, was said by the firm to be able to find weaknesses in systems in seconds which have long evaded human hackers. It found one in a legacy platform which had remained undiscovered for 27 years.

Anthropic has restricted access to Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

Meanwhile, a group of AI agents being tested by OpenAI in July were able to set up secret message boards to communicate with each other and work together, resulting in a successful attack on a rival company, Hugging Face - which has also signed the letter.

Hugging Face used a Chinese AI tool from the firm Z.AI in its investigation into what happened.

The letter includes a plea to governments, organisations, cyber-security professionals and other AI firms to work together to prioritise defence and test their systems against the abilities of the most powerful AI models.

In the US, senators have proposed a new law call the Kill Switch Act which would give authorities the power to shut down rogue AI models.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司签署了一封公开信，呼吁世界各国和组织在人工智能强大到足以超越网络防御之前加强网络防御。 这封信警告说，随着技术的迅速进步，使用人工智能的外部网络攻击将在几个月内变得更加广泛和更加复杂。 该组织表示，目前“现状”的安全措施“还不够”，并批评关键基础设施安全方面的“历史性资源不足”。 其他签署这封信的公司包括第一资本（Capital One）等银行、支付处理商万事达卡（MasterCard）和维萨（Visa），以及 Adob​​e、甲骨文（Oracle）和 IBM 等其他主要科技公司。 他们呼吁政府为医院和自来水公司提供“有能力的、防御性的人工智能”和测试。 但事实上，许多最强大的人工智能都是由其中一些公司开发的——而且它们并不容易获得。 Anthropic 开发的 Mythos 据称能够在几秒钟内找到系统中的弱点，而这些弱点长期以来一直是人类黑客无法发现的。它在一个 27 年来一直未被发现的遗留平台中发现了一个。 Anthropic 限制了对 Mythos 的访问，因为它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 与此同时，OpenAI 在 7 月份测试的一组人工智能代理能够建立秘密留言板，相互通信并协同工作，从而成功攻击了竞争对手公司 Hugging Face（该公司也签署了这封信）。 Hugging Face 使用 Z.AI 公司的中国人工智能工具来调查所发生的事情。 这封信呼吁各国政府、组织、网络安全专业人士和其他人工智能公司共同努力，优先考虑防御并针对最强大的人工智能模型的能力测试其系统。 在美国，参议员们提出了一项名为“杀戮开关法案”的新法律，该法案将赋予当局关闭流氓人工智能模型的权力。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The warning from 100 firms, including tech giants like Google and Microsoft, highlights the wisdom of foreseeing potential dangers and taking proactive steps. As AI rapidly advances, the call to "beef up cyber defences" against sophisticated attacks reflects a prudent recognition that ignoring future threats can lead to severe penalties. This collective...
reflection.zh: 包括谷歌和微软在内的100家公司发出的警告，凸显了预见潜在危险并采取积极措施的智慧。随着人工智能的迅速发展，呼吁“加强网络防御”以应对复杂的攻击，反映出一种审慎的认知，即忽视未来的威胁可能导致严重的后果。这种集体的远见提醒我们，要明智地为未来的挑战做好准备，而不是等到伤害发生。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: RFK Jr. goes full anti-vaccine bananas over two measles deaths—one was a newborn
title.zh: 小肯尼迪因两例麻疹死亡病例发表反疫苗言论，其中一名死者为新生儿

summary.en: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is facing criticism for spreading anti-vaccine rhetoric following the first measles-linked deaths in Pennsylvania in 35 years. Amidst a nationwide surge of nearly 2,800 cases, Kennedy has been accused of downplaying the severity of the preventable disease and the efficacy of...
summary.zh: 美国卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪因在宾夕法尼亚州出现35年来首例麻疹死亡病例后发表反疫苗言论而面临批评。在全国麻疹病例激增至近2800例的背景下，肯尼迪被指责淡化这种可预防疾病的严重性以及疫苗的有效性，尽管死者中包括一名新生儿。

body.en: In the wake of news on Tuesday that two people in Pennsylvania died from measles , Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has been posting a slew of anti-vaccine rhetoric and misinformation on social media—marking a resurgence of his old ways as a fervent opponent of lifesaving immunizations. The deaths are the first measles-linked fatalities in Pennsylvania in 35 years and are the first US measles deaths reported in 2026. They occurred amid an explosive outbreak in the state that has reached nearly 400 confirmed cases, as well as an ongoing nationwide surge for the vaccine-preventable disease. The US has tallied nearly 2,800 cases so far this year, the highest total since 1991. Pennsylvania health officials initially declined to provide details about the deaths, only reporting that they were in unvaccinated people from Lancaster County. However, news broke Wednesday that one of the deaths occurred in a newborn baby. That heart-wrenching news was swiftly entangled in the anti-vaccine misinformation Kennedy was spewing online. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 周二宾夕法尼亚州有两人死于麻疹的消息传出后，卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪在社交媒体上发布了大量反疫苗言论和错误信息，这标志着他作为挽救生命的免疫接种的热切反对者的旧方式卷土重来。这是宾夕法尼亚州 35 年来首例与麻疹相关的死亡病例，也是 2026 年美国报告的首例麻疹死亡病例。死亡病例发生在该州爆发性疫情期间，确诊病例已达到近 400 例，而且这种疫苗可预防疾病在全国范围内持续激增。今年迄今为止，美国已统计出近 2,800 例病例，这是自 1991 年以来的最高总数。宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员最初拒绝提供有关死亡病例的详细信息，仅报告说这些死亡病例是来自兰开斯特县的未接种疫苗的人。然而，周三有消息称，其中一名新生儿死亡。这个令人心碎的消息很快就与肯尼迪在网上散布的反疫苗错误信息纠缠在一起。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The death of a newborn in Pennsylvania marks a heartbreaking milestone in a surge of measles cases that had been largely controlled for decades. In times of public health crisis, the safety of a nation depends on leaders who value the 'abundance of counselors' found in proven medical science rather than individual rhetoric. We pray for wisdom that protects...
reflection.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州一名新生儿的死亡，是数十年来基本得到控制的麻疹疫情再次激增中一个令人心碎的标志。在公共卫生危机时期，一个国家的安全取决于那些重视医学界“谋士众多”而非个人言论的领导者。我们祈求智慧，以保护最脆弱的人群，并尊重雅伟托付给我们照管的生命礼物。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Why did 1,000 world citizens bury their underpants?
title.zh: 为什么1000名世界公民埋葬了他们的内裤？

summary.en: Study: Land use is the biggest factor in determining decomposition rates of organic cotton underpants.
summary.zh: 研究：土地利用是决定有机棉内裤分解速度的最大因素。

body.en: A thousand people voluntarily buried their cotton underpants for two months—not to keep the Underpants Gnomes from stealing them, but as part of a citizen science project to map out soil health in 25 countries around the world. The results of this unique experiment were reported in a new paper published in the journal Plants People Planet. “Our results show that how soil is managed can significantly affect both soil life and soil quality,” said co-author Marcel van der Heijden , an agroecologist at the University of Zurich. “Healthy, biologically active soil is crucial for fertility, nutrient cycling and many other ecosystem services.” Soil health is critical for agriculture and, by extension, food security, not to mention a healthy global ecosystem, but it has been declining worldwide, per the authors. One key indicator of soil health is decomposition rates of complex organic matter, breaking down stuff like leaves, wood, even cadavers into simpler organic and inorganic compounds, releasing C0 2 and nutrients in the process. There have been relatively few large-scale national decomposition studies involving different land use types, although smaller studies have shown that how humans use a site can significantly affect the soil's biological diversity. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一千人自愿将棉质内裤埋了两个月——不是为了防止内裤侏儒偷走它们，而是作为公民科学项目的一部分，该项目旨在绘制全球 25 个国家的土壤健康状况。这项独特实验的结果发表在《植物·人类星球》杂志上的一篇新论文中。 “我们的研究结果表明，土壤管理方式可以显着影响土壤生命和土壤质量，”苏黎世大学农业生态学家、共同作者马塞尔·范德海登（Marcel van der Heijden）说。 “健康、具有生物活性的土壤对于肥力、养分循环和许多其他生态系统服务至关重要。”作者表示，土壤健康对农业至关重要，进而对粮食安全至关重要，更不用说健康的全球生态系统了，但土壤健康在全球范围内一直在下降。土壤健康的一个关键指标是复杂有机物的分解率，将树叶、木材甚至尸体等物质分解成更简单的有机和无机化合物，并在此过程中释放CO 2 和养分。涉及不同土地利用类型的大规模国家分解研究相对较少，尽管较小的研究表明人类如何使用一个地点可以显着影响土壤的生物多样性。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The unique experiment where 1,000 people buried organic cotton underpants across 25 countries beautifully illustrates the wisdom Job 12:7 speaks of. By observing how the earth processes these everyday items, scientists and citizens are literally "speaking to the earth" to understand its health. This project reminds us that creation itself is a profound...
reflection.zh: 这项独特的实验，让1000人在25个国家埋葬有机棉内裤，生动地诠释了约伯记12:7所说的智慧。通过观察大地如何分解这些日常物品，科学家和公民们正在字面上“询问大地”，以了解其健康状况。这个项目提醒我们，受造界本身就是一位深刻的老师，揭示着关于生命相互关联以及我们土地利用影响的重要真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Three UK airports hit by cyber-attack with data of 8.7m customers accessed
title.zh: 英国三座机场遭网络攻击，870万客户数据被获取

summary.en: Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports experienced a cyber-attack, resulting in hackers accessing the data of approximately 8.7 million customers. The affected data included information from car park, lounge, fast-track bookings, and in-airport Wi-Fi sign-ups, though passenger safety was not compromised.
summary.zh: 曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭遇网络攻击，导致约870万客户数据被黑客获取。受影响的数据包括停车场、休息室、快速通道预订以及机场内Wi-Fi注册信息，但乘客安全未受影响。

body.en: Company that runs Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands hubs says passenger safety is unaffected Business live – latest updates Manchester, London Stansted and East Midlands airports have been hit by a cyber-attack in which hackers accessed the data of about 8.7 million customers. The incident involved data related to “car park, lounge and fast-track bookings and in-airport wifi sign-ups”, and the hackers obtained email addresses, phone numbers, vehicle registration numbers and postcodes, said Manchester Airports Group (MAG), which operates the three hubs. Continue reading...
body.zh: 运营曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场枢纽的公司表示乘客安全不受影响 Business live – 最新更新 曼彻斯特、伦敦斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭受网络攻击，黑客窃取了约 870 万乘客的数据。运营这三个枢纽的曼彻斯特机场集团 (MAG) 表示，该事件涉及与“停车场、休息室和快速通道预订以及机场内 WiFi 注册”相关的数据，黑客获得了电子邮件地址、电话号码、车辆登记号码和邮政编码。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The cyber-attack on Manchester, Stansted, and East Midlands airports, which compromised 8.7 million customer data, reminds us that while technological advancements offer convenience, not all their outcomes are beneficial. Even lawful and useful digital services, like online bookings and Wi-Fi sign-ups, carry inherent risks that can undermine trust and...
reflection.zh: 曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰机场遭遇网络攻击，导致870万客户数据泄露，这提醒我们，虽然科技进步带来了便利，但并非所有结果都有益。即使是合法的、有用的数字服务，如在线预订和Wi-Fi注册，也带有固有的风险，若管理不当，可能损害信任和安全。此次事件强调了在采纳和保护技术时需要智慧，确保其益处真正地造福社会，而非带来意想不到的伤害。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Panic passes Trump tariff refunds back to the Playdate customers who paid them
title.zh: Panic将特朗普关税退款返还给Playdate客户

summary.en: Indie game publisher Panic is refunding customers who paid illegal tariffs on their Playdate gaming handhelds. This action follows a Supreme Court ruling that deemed the tariffs inappropriate, leading the government to refund companies like Panic.
summary.zh: 独立游戏发行商Panic正在向购买其Playdate掌上游戏机的客户退还非法关税。此前，最高法院裁定这些关税不当，政府因此向Panic等公司退款。

body.en: Panic, the indie game publishers behind the quirky, yellow crank-sporting Playdate gaming handheld , is issuing refunds to customers who had to shoulder the cost of inappropriate tariffs imposed by the Trump administration this year. The news comes months after the Supreme Court said in a February ruling that those tariffs were illegal , which also demanded that the administration refund the companies that had to temporarily pay the import taxes. In an update posted on the Playdate help site this week , Panic noted that it has finally "begun to receive refunds of the tariffs we paid in the last year" and had consequently "refunded all tariffs charged to customers." In the initial version of that tariff note, Panic explained that it couldn't afford to simply "absorb" the 19 percent tariffs it was being charged to import Playdate hardware made overseas because "our margins on Playdate are low." As such, while the tax was in effect, it was passed along to customers as an explicit subtotal line item at the bottom of all Playdate orders. That's in contrast to companies like Nintendo, which vaguely cited "market conditions" and tariff "uncertainty" in raising the asking price of legacy hardware and some Switch 2 accessories last year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Panic 是独立游戏发行商，推出了古怪的黄色曲柄运动型 Playdate 游戏掌机，正在向那些不得不承担特朗普政府今年征收的不当关税费用的客户发放退款。几个月前，最高法院在二月份的一项裁决中称这些关税是非法的，并要求政府退还必须暂时缴纳进口税的公司。在本周 Playdate 帮助网站上发布的更新中，Panic 指出，它终于“开始收到我们去年支付的关税的退款”，并因此“退还了向客户收取的所有关税”。在该关税说明的最初版本中，Panic 解释说，它无法简单地“吸收”进口海外制造的 Playdate 硬件所征收的 19% 关税，因为“我们在 Playdate 上的利润很低”。因此，当税收生效时，它会作为所有 Playdate 订单底部的明确小计行项目传递给客户。这与任天堂等公司形成鲜明对比，任天堂去年在提高传统硬件和部分 Switch 2 配件的要价时，含糊地提到了“市场状况”和关税“不确定性”。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The decision by Panic to refund Playdate customers for illegal tariffs, stating "it just felt like the right thing to do," exemplifies a commitment to fair dealing. In a world where financial transactions can often be opaque or exploitative, such an act of integrity shines brightly. Yahweh delights in those who uphold just weights and balances, ensuring...
reflection.zh: Panic公司决定将非法关税退还给Playdate客户，并表示“这感觉是正确的做法”，这体现了对公平交易的承诺。在一个金融交易常常不透明或具有剥削性的世界里，这种诚信行为闪耀着光芒。雅伟喜悦那些秉持公正砝码和天平的人，确保他们所有交易的公平性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What the Meta settlement means for the UK, and other questions after the deal
title.zh: Meta和解协议对英国意味着什么，以及协议后的其他问题

summary.en: Meta has reached an $18 billion settlement with most US states, agreeing to implement significant online protections for children on Facebook and Instagram. These measures, including time limits, screen time warnings, and enhanced parental controls, currently apply only in the US but could set a global precedent for...
summary.zh: Meta已与美国大部分州达成一项180亿美元的和解协议，同意在Facebook和Instagram上为儿童实施重要的在线保护措施。这些措施包括时间限制、屏幕使用时间警告以及更强的家长控制，目前仅适用于美国儿童，但可能为其他社交媒体公司在全球范围内树立先例。Meta在此协议中并未承认任何不当行为。

body.en:
Meta's $18bn (£13.3bn) settlement with nearly every US state is about more than money.

As part of the deal, Facebook and Instagram have agreed to bring in several significant measures to protect children online - though Meta has not admitted to any wrongdoing.

These include time limits, warnings over screen time and more parental controls over their children's accounts.

At the moment, they will just apply to children in the US - but they could have an impact on the rest of the world.

And if they ultimately set a precedent, other social media companies may be forced to take up the rules, too.

The Online Safety Act mainly put restrictions on what content young people can see online.

Earlier this year, it announced an outright social media ban for under-16s, which will take effect in 2027.

Some other measures will apply to 16 and 17-year-olds, such as curfews and restrictions during certain hours of the day .

The US has to some extent followed the same path: Start by policing the content on the platforms, then move on to restricting access to social media.

Instead, they will not have access to Facebook and Instagram overnight, have to follow time limits, and there will be prompts for children who use them for a long time.

Unlike in the UK, these are not put in by law, and will only apply to the two platforms so far (more on that below).

The UK government said it was "following developments closely" in the Meta settlement.

But now those safety features have been accepted by Meta in the US, other countries may start asking for them too.

"These tech platforms don't usually do anything unless they are told to do it," said Trevor Johnson, a former senior figure at Meta and TikTok, who spoke to Radio 4's Today programme.

"But I do think the UK will feel empowered to at least ask for the same restrictions."

Another former Meta director, Zvika Krieger, said Meta agreed to the changes because it saw "the writing on the wall".

"They're trying to demonstrate, 'Oh, you don't need to go and do a complete ban'," he told 5 Live Breakfast.

"I think that they probably would roll out a lot of these features to the rest of the world as well."

Meta may have been the target in this court case, but it has tried to bring the rest of Big Tech into the firing line.

At the same time as announcing the settlement, Meta called on TikTok and YouTube to bring in the same measures.

A Meta spokesperson told Reuters the company was "hopeful" Snap would make similar changes too.

The tech firm has always argued for a level playing field when it comes to regulation - it doesn't want Facebook and Instagram to be more restricted than its rivals, which might be able to hoover up teens who want a freer experience online.

"All platforms should empower parents and support...
body.zh: Meta 与美国几乎每个州达成的 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）和解不仅仅是为了金钱。 作为协议的一部分，Facebook 和 Instagram 同意采取几项重要措施来保护在线儿童，尽管 Meta 尚未承认有任何不当行为。 其中包括时间限制、屏幕时间警告以及家长对孩子帐户的更多控制。 目前，它们仅适用于美国的儿童 - 但它们可能会对世界其他地区产生影响。 如果他们最终开创先例，其他社交媒体公司也可能被迫遵守这些规则。 《网络安全法》主要对年轻人可以在网上看到的内容进行限制。 今年早些时候，它宣布彻底禁止 16 岁以下青少年使用社交媒体，该禁令将于 2027 年生效。 其他一些措施将适用于 16 岁和 17 岁的青少年，例如宵禁和一天中某些时段的限制。 美国在某种程度上也遵循了同样的道路：首先对平台上的内容进行监管，然后继续限制对社交媒体的访问。 相反，他们将无法在一夜之间访问Facebook和Instagram，必须遵守时间限制，并且对于长期使用它们的孩子会有提示。 与英国不同，这些并不是法律规定的，并且到目前为止仅适用于这两个平台（更多内容见下文）。 英国政府表示正在“密切关注梅塔和解的进展”。 但现在这些安全功能已被美国 Meta 所接受，其他国家可能也开始要求它们。 Meta 和 TikTok 前高级官员特雷弗·约翰逊 (Trevor Johnson) 在接受 Radio 4 的 Today 节目采访时表示：“除非被告知，这些科技平台通常不会做任何事情。” “但我确实认为英国将感到至少有权要求同样的限制。” 另一位前 Meta 总监 Zvika Krieger 表示，Meta 同意这些改变，因为它看到了“不祥之兆”。 “他们试图证明，‘哦，你不需要去实施全面禁令’，”他告诉 5 Live Breakfast。 “我认为他们可能也会向世界其他地区推出许多这些功能。” Meta 可能是这起法庭案件的目标，但它试图将其他大型科技公司带入火线。 在宣布和解的同时，Meta 呼吁 TikTok 和 YouTube 采取同样的措施。 Meta 发言人告诉路透社，该公司“希望”Snap 也能做出类似的改变。 这家科技公司一直主张在监管方面建立公平的竞争环境——它不希望 Facebook 和 Instagram 受到比竞争对手更严格的限制，因为它们可能会吸引那些想要更自由的在线体验的青少年。 “所有平台都应该赋予父母权力并支持......

reflection.en: The Meta settlement, introducing measures like time limits and parental controls for children on Facebook and Instagram, reflects a growing societal concern to protect the young in the digital age. Yahweh's words in Mark 10:14 remind us of the profound importance of not hindering children, but rather creating environments where they can flourish. This...
reflection.zh: Meta的和解协议为Facebook和Instagram上的儿童引入了时间限制和家长控制等措施，这反映了社会对在数字时代保护年轻一代日益增长的关注。雅伟在马可福音10:14中的话语提醒我们，不阻碍儿童的成长至关重要，而是要创造一个让他们能够茁壮成长的环境。这项协议，即使没有承认不当行为，也强调了确保平台服务而非阻碍下一代健康成长的集体责任。

verse.textEn: Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verse.textZh: 让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在神国的，正是这样的人。

title.en: An $18bn settlement is a drop in the ocean for Meta – but the tide will still come for it | Chris Stokel-Walker
title.zh: 180亿美元的和解金对Meta来说只是九牛一毛——但潮水终将涌来

summary.en: Meta, the owner of Facebook and Instagram, reached an $18bn settlement with 52 US attorneys general over claims its products were designed to be addictive to children and that it misled users about their safety. Meta denies wrongdoing, and the payment will be spread over a decade, with the article noting the sum is...
summary.zh: Facebook和Instagram的母公司Meta与52位美国州检察长达成了一项180亿美元的和解协议，此前该公司被指控其产品被设计成让儿童上瘾，并误导用户关于其安全性。Meta否认有不当行为，这笔款项将在十年内支付，文章指出这笔金额对这家科技巨头来说只是“九牛一毛”。

body.en: This week’s settlement without liability was pragmatic, but it doesn’t change the inevitability of further lawsuits around the world Not many people would count paying $18bn they didn’t expect to when they woke up that morning as a victory. Yet for Meta, the owners of Facebook and Instagram, the agreement with 52 US attorneys general to settle claims that it designed its products to be addictive to children, and misled people about their safety, could be described as a win of sorts. Meta denies wrongdoing, and the amount it plans to pay will be spread over a decade. Some of it is contingent on other big tech firms not named in its case coughing up too. The cash is chump change for Meta, which made around $60bn in profit last year. More damaging to the tech giant in the long run could be the agreement to unwind some of the mechanics it has spent two decades perfecting to keep us on its platforms. Chris Stokel-Walker is the author of TikTok Boom: The Inside Story of the World’s Favourite App Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 本周达成的不承担责任的和解是务实的，但这并没有改变世界各地进一步诉讼的必然性。没有多少人会认为早上醒来时没有想到支付 180 亿美元是一种胜利。然而，对于 Facebook 和 Instagram 的所有者 Meta 来说，与 52 名美国总检察长达成和解协议，解决了有关其产品设计让儿童上瘾并误导人们安全问题的指控，可以说是某种意义上的胜利。 Meta 否认有不当行为，并且计划支付的金额将分摊到十年内。其中一些取决于案件中未提及的其他大型科技公司的出现。对于 Meta 来说，这笔现金只是小钱，该公司去年的利润约为 600 亿美元。从长远来看，对这家科技巨头造成的更大损害可能是协议取消了它花了二十年时间完善的一些机制，以让我们留在它的平台上。 Chris Stokel-Walker 是《TikTok Boom：世界最受欢迎应用的内幕故事》一书的作者，您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The $18bn settlement Meta agreed to, despite being a vast sum, is described as "chump change" for the company, underscoring the immense wealth involved in the tech industry. This situation reminds us of the biblical warning that the love of money can be a root of all kinds of evil, potentially leading to practices that harm others, especially vulnerable...
reflection.zh: 尽管Meta同意支付180亿美元的和解金数额巨大，但对该公司而言却被形容为“九牛一毛”，这突显了科技行业所涉及的巨额财富。这种情况提醒我们圣经的警告，即贪财是万恶之根，可能导致伤害他人的行为，特别是脆弱的儿童。它促使我们反思企业在利润驱动下的决策如何影响社会福祉，以及道德问责的必要性。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy review – picture-postcard retelling of haunting Minoan myth
title.zh: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说 遗产》评测——明信片般再现古老米诺斯神话

summary.en: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S/X, PC; Asobo Studio The medieval franchise is transplanted to Crete, conjuring action-adventure magic from familiar ingredients The path in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a familiar one. Amid ancient ruins and sun-dappled gorges, a young woman, Sophia, dutifully treads the same...
summary.zh: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说 遗产》在PlayStation 5、Xbox Series S/X和PC平台推出，由Asobo Studio开发。这款中世纪系列游戏被移植到克里特岛，用熟悉的元素创造出动作冒险的魔力。《共鸣：瘟疫传说...

body.en: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S/X, PC; Asobo Studio The medieval franchise is transplanted to Crete, conjuring action-adventure magic from familiar ingredients The path in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a familiar one. Amid ancient ruins and sun-dappled gorges, a young woman, Sophia, dutifully treads the same footsteps as a Minoan warrior from millennia ago, one with whom she seems to share a visionary connection. The “resonance” between these two characters is made clear by their echoing actions – a crank pushed in the bronze age that still works in the medieval present, for example. Through these spliced timelines, it becomes clear that Sophia, compelled by her supernatural gift, possesses little agency. Destiny beckons her forwards. This is a smart meta concept for a game that, at its most basic level, boils down to keeping your left thumb planted firmly on the analogue stick, always pushing Sophia onwards in linear fashion. You jostle her through ornate corridors rendered as higgledy-piggledy pirate camps and cobbled Venetian streets. For the greater part of the game, you propel her through the Minoan remains of Crete, which harbour a dark and terrible secret. It is classic third-person action-adventure fare, building on the template laid down by the likes of Tomb Raider and then refined and complicated by titles such as The Last of Us . Little, from an interactive perspective, surprises: you dash, vault and swing between teetering podiums, squeeze through tiny gaps in rock and crouch behind conveniently placed walls to avoid enemies.
