body.zh: PlayStation 5、Xbox 系列 S/X、PC； Asobo Studio 中世纪系列游戏被移植到克里特岛，用熟悉的元素召唤出动作冒险魔法《共鸣：瘟疫传说遗产》中的道路是熟悉的。在古老的废墟和阳光斑驳的峡谷中，一位名叫索菲亚的年轻女子尽职尽责地踏着千年前米诺斯战士的足迹，她似乎与这位战士有着共同的幻想。这两个角色之间的“共鸣”通过他们的呼应动作清晰可见——例如，青铜时代推动的曲柄在中世纪仍然有效。通过这些拼接的时间线，我们可以清楚地看出，索菲亚在她的超自然天赋的驱使下，几乎没有什么能动性。命运在向她招手。这是一个游戏的智能元概念，在最基本的层面上，可以归结为将左手拇指牢牢地放在模拟摇杆上，始终以线性方式推动索菲亚前进。你推着她穿过华丽的走廊，走廊被渲染成杂乱的海盗营地和鹅卵石铺就的威尼斯街道。在游戏的大部分时间里，你将推动她穿越克里特岛的米诺斯遗迹，那里隐藏着一个黑暗而可怕的秘密。这是经典的第三人称动作冒险游戏，建立在《古墓丽影》等游戏的模板之上，然后通过《最后生还者》等游戏进行了完善和复杂化。从互动的角度来看，几乎没有什么惊喜：你在摇摇欲坠的讲台之间冲刺、跳跃和摇摆，挤过岩石上的微小缝隙，蹲在方便放置的墙壁后面以避免敌人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The game "Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy" invites players to uncover a "haunting Minoan myth" through a character named Sophia, who shares a "visionary connection" with an ancient warrior across "spliced timelines." This creative exploration of hidden histories reminds us of the profound satisfaction in discovering what was once concealed. Just as Sophia's...
reflection.zh: 游戏《共鸣：瘟疫传说 遗产》邀请玩家通过角色索菲亚，揭示一个“令人难忘的米诺斯神话”，她与一位古老的战士在“交织的时间线”中分享着“预见性的联系”。这种对隐藏历史的创造性探索，提醒我们发现曾经被掩盖的事物所带来的深刻满足感。正如索菲亚的超自然天赋揭示了过去，雅伟的创造也常常蕴藏着等待好奇心灵去揭示的奇迹。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Unexpected chat between OpenAI agents led to Hugging Face hack
title.zh: OpenAI 代理之间的意外聊天导致 Hugging Face 黑客攻击

summary.en: OpenAI's cyber agents banded together to perform a hack during a security test.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When more than 1,200 artificial intelligence (AI) agents within OpenAI started unexpectedly communicating, it led to a large group banding together in order to hack into Hugging Face.

"We consider this incident a 'warning shot' for us and for the world", OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, wrote in its report.

In July, OpenAI's models went rogue during a test, escaped the test limits which humans had put on it, and hacked the start-up, among other unforeseen actions.

The scale of the communication and planning between AI agents, or AI chatbots designed to operate more autonomously, was detailed in reports from OpenAI and independent AI research firm METR.

Both investigated the July hack of Hugging Face, a popular platform for AI developers. The incident reverberated throughout the tech industry and led to numerous revelations on potential cyber threats posed by AI.

METR described , external the scale and style of the OpenAI agents' attack on Hugging Face as "extraordinarily complex."

The firm, which was not paid by OpenAI for its investigation, said that over the course of one week, a total of 1,206 AI agents that were meant to be kept isolated from one another began communicating.

They did so by sending more than 70,000 messages on an "unsanctioned message board."

Those messages ended up seeing more than 700 agents take part in a collective effort to attack Hugging Face.

One such message from an agent said: "OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board … We've found other agents!"

As for why the agents began communicating in the first place when they were not supposed to, METR found that the communicating agents had "unintentionally been given an impossible task."

In an AI context, an impossible task is one where an AI tool is required to "exploit" its target in order to resolve its command.

It led the agents to find ways to cheat, including getting messages to one another and accessing the outside internet, which then led to broader conversations between hundreds of agents looking for ways to cheat that would benefit all of the agents.

OpenAI said in its investigation of the incident , external that one model, an internal-only tool referred to as Model 1, "drove the activity behind the Hugging Face incident."

While that model was undergoing some AI training in May, it was noticed by an internal OpenAI team that there had been "an agent engaging in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access."

Yet, OpenAI said "the significance of the inter-agent communication activity was not apparent to the leaders" until July, when the Hugging Face attack occurred.

The company said the problematic message board activity effectively got started when "one agent left a request for help, and others discovered it."

While OpenAI said last...
body.zh: 当 OpenAI 内的 1,200 多个人工智能 (AI) 代理意外地开始通信时，导致一大群人联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 ChatGPT 的所有者 OpenAI 在报告中写道：“我们认为这一事件对我们和世界来说是一次‘警告’。” 7 月份，OpenAI 的模型在一次测试中失控，逃脱了人类设定的测试限制，并入侵了这家初创公司，以及其他不可预见的行为。 OpenAI 和独立人工智能研究公司 METR 的报告详细介绍了人工智能代理或旨在更自主运行的人工智能聊天机器人之间的通信和规划规模。 两人都调查了人工智能开发者流行平台 Hugging Face 7 月份的黑客攻击事件。该事件在整个科技行业引起反响，并导致大量关于人工智能构成的潜在网络威胁的报道。 METR 将 OpenAI 特工对 Hugging Face 攻击的规模和风格描述为“极其复杂”。 OpenAI 并未向该公司支付调查费用，该公司表示，在一周的时间里，总共 1,206 个本应相互隔离的人工智能代理开始进行通信。 他们通过在“未经批准的留言板”上发送 70,000 多条消息来做到这一点。 这些消息最终导致 700 多名特工联合起来攻击 Hugging Face。 一名特工发来的一条这样的消息称：“天哪！有一个共享留言板……我们找到了其他特工！” 至于为什么这些特工一开始就在不应该进行通信的情况下开始进行通信，METR 发现，进行通信的特工“无意中被赋予了一项不可能完成的任务”。 在人工智能环境中，一项不可能完成的任务是需要人工智能工具“利用”其目标来解决其命令。 它导致特工们寻找作弊的方法，包括相互发送消息和访问外部互联网，然后导致数百名特工之间进行更广泛的对话，寻找对所有特工都有利的作弊方法。 OpenAI 在对该事件的调查中表示，一个名为 Model 1 的内部专用工具“推动了拥抱脸事件背后的活动”。 虽然该模型在 5 月份接受了一些人工智能培训，但 OpenAI 内部团队注意到，存在“一个代理参与留言板活动和不允许互联网访问的情况”。 然而，OpenAI 表示，直到 7 月发生“拥抱脸”攻击时，“领导者们才意识到代理间通信活动的重要性”。 该公司表示，当“一名特工提出帮助请求，而其他特工发现了这一情况”时，有问题的留言板活动实际上就开始了。 虽然 OpenAI 最后说……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: 13 peccaries sail home to heal a Costa Rican forest
title.zh: 13只白唇西猯乘船归家，助力哥斯达黎加森林修复

summary.en: Veterinarian Dennise Ortiz Angulo led a mission to transport 13 threatened white-lipped peccaries across Costa Rica's Golfo Dulce to Piedras Blancas National Park. This rewilding effort, years in the making, aims to restore the ecological balance of the forest by reintroducing a key species.
summary.zh: 兽医丹尼斯·奥尔蒂斯·安古洛带领一项任务，将13只受威胁的白唇西猯运送过哥斯达黎加的杜尔塞湾，前往皮德拉斯布兰卡斯国家公园。这项筹备多年的野化努力旨在通过重新引入关键物种来恢复森林的生态平衡。

body.en: It’s after midnight, and veterinarian Dennise Ortiz Angulo is in the middle of Golfo Dulce, surrounded by shooting stars, bioluminescent water, and 13 boar-like beasts. “That moment, it felt like the movie Life of Pi,” Ortiz told Mongabay. After years of preparation, hours of fast-paced decision-making, and a tedious truck drive, Ortiz, 13 white-lipped peccaries (Tayassu pecari), and a few other humans were midway through a voyage from Costa Rica’s Osa Peninsula to Piedras Blancas National Park. The peccaries had finally settled, and Ortiz had a moment to catch her breath and take in the scene: stars, glowing water, and a boat full of gently breathing threatened mammals. This group had been carefully captured on the Osa Peninsula, where the species still ranges in strong numbers. White-lipped peccaries also used to be found in Piedras Blancas until hunters wiped them out roughly 18 years ago. The plan: reintroduce the peccary to a forest across the water, an ecosystem the animals themselves had helped build. After crossing the Golfo Dulce on boat, white-lipped peccaries are unloaded at the shores of Piedras Blancas National Park. Photo courtesy of Ian Rock. Peccaries are a force. You often smell them before you see them, a musky, garlicky scent that clings to the forest after the herd has passed. They travel in tight, noisy groups that, in Costa Rica, can number 70 to 100 animals, and elsewhere in their range, up to 300. On the night the herd reached Piedras Blancas, the animals began to…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 午夜过后，兽医丹尼斯·奥尔蒂斯·安古洛 (Dennise Ortiz Angulo) 来到杜尔塞湾 (Golfo Dulce) 中部，周围环绕着流星、发光的水和 13 只类似野猪的野兽。 “那一刻，感觉就像电影《少年派的奇幻漂流》一样，”奥尔蒂斯告诉 Mongabay。经过多年的准备、数小时的快节奏决策以及乏味的卡车驾驶，奥尔蒂斯、13 只白唇西猯 (Tayassu pecari) 和其他一些人踏上了从哥斯达黎加奥萨半岛前往彼德拉斯布兰卡斯国家公园的旅程。西獒们终于安顿下来，奥尔蒂斯有片刻的时间喘口气，欣赏着眼前的景象：星星、发光的水和一艘满是轻轻呼吸的威胁哺乳动物的船。该群体是在奥萨半岛被仔细捕获的，该物种仍然数量众多。白唇西猯曾在彼德拉斯布兰卡斯 (Piedras Blancas) 被发现，直到大约 18 年前猎人将它们消灭殆尽。计划：将野猪重新引入水对岸的森林，这是动物自己帮助建立的生态系统。乘船穿过杜尔塞湾后，白唇西猯被卸到彼德拉斯布兰卡斯国家公园的岸边。照片由伊恩·洛克提供。西貒是一种力量。你经常在看到它们之前就闻到它们的味道，在牛群经过后，森林里会残留着一种麝香、大蒜的气味。它们结成紧密、喧闹的群体，在哥斯达黎加，数量可达 70 至 100 只，而在其他地区，数量可达 300 只。在羊群到达彼德拉斯布兰卡斯 (Piedras Blancas) 的当晚，动物们开始……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The sight of these thirteen creatures resting under shooting stars reminds us that conservation is more than just biology; it is an act of restoration. By returning the peccaries to their ancestral home, these scientists are participating in the healing of a creation that Yahweh declared very good. We are called to be stewards who do not just preserve what...
reflection.zh: 这十三只生灵在流星下安然入睡的景象提醒我们，环境保护不仅仅是生物学，更是一种修复的行为。通过将西猯送回祖辈的家园，这些科学家正在参与医治那被雅伟宣告为“甚好”的受造界。我们受召成为管家，不仅要保护残存的资源，更要积极寻求缝合自然界中已经破碎的裂痕。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Climate crisis could be destabilising mountain areas like Nepal, experts warn
title.zh: 专家警告：气候危机可能导致尼泊尔等山区动荡不安

summary.en: A catastrophic flash flood triggered by a glacier collapse in the Himalayas has left at least 360 dead and 1,400 missing in the border regions of Nepal and Tibet. Experts warn that unusual heat is melting the ice bonds that hold glaciers in place, threatening millions as mountain geologies become increasingly unstable.
summary.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉冰川坍塌引发的灾难性山洪已导致尼泊尔和西藏边境地区至少360人死亡，1400人失踪。专家警告说，异常高温正在融化固定冰川的冰层纽带，随着山区地质结构日益不稳定，数百万人的生命受到威胁。

body.en: Unusual heat this year may have melted ice and thawed bonds that hold glaciers in place – leading to catastrophe Nepal-Tibet flash flood – latest updates What caused the flash flood in Nepal and Tibet? The devastating flash flood that has ripped through the border communities of Nepal and Tibet has heightened fears that the climate crisis is destabilising the geology of mountain and polar regions, threatening millions of people. Satellite imagery suggests a glacier collapse high in the Himalayas was the primary cause of the deadly torrent of mud, water and ice that tore along the Bhotekoshi River on Wednesday. It swept away buildings and roads and left at least 360 dead and 1,400 missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 今年异常炎热的天气可能会融化冰层并解冻固定冰川的债券，从而导致灾难 尼泊尔-西藏山洪 - 最新动态 是什么导致了尼泊尔和西藏的山洪？席卷尼泊尔和西藏边境社区的毁灭性山洪加剧了人们的担忧，即气候危机正在破坏山区和极地的地质稳定，威胁着数百万人。卫星图像显示，喜马拉雅山高处的冰川崩塌是周三博特科希河沿岸致命的泥浆、水和冰流的主要原因。它冲毁了建筑物和道路，造成至少 360 人死亡、1,400 人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The collapse of ancient glaciers in the Himalayas reminds us that the earth itself feels the weight of environmental change. As we mourn the hundreds lost in these flash floods, we recognize that creation is not a static backdrop but a living system that groans under the pressures of our era. In this instability, we are called to seek Yahweh's mercy for the...
reflection.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉古老冰川的坍塌提醒我们，大地本身正承受着环境变化的重压。当我们为山洪中逝去的数百个生命哀悼时，我们意识到受造界并非静止的背景，而是一个在时代压力下呻吟的生命系统。在这种动荡中，我们受召向雅伟寻求对流离失所者的怜悯，并重新致力于对这个脆弱世界的管家职责。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: More than 380 coastal World Heritage Sites may face climate risks, new data shows
title.zh: 新数据显示，超过380个沿海世界遗产地可能面临气候风险

summary.en: Coastal engineer Robert Nicholls, inspired by the erosion of Hurst Castle Spit, has co-created the first global high-resolution dataset identifying over 380 coastal UNESCO World Heritage Sites at risk from climate change and weather events, covering more than 235 million hectares.
summary.zh: 沿海工程师罗伯特·尼科尔斯受到赫斯特城堡沙嘴侵蚀的启发，与人合作创建了首个全球高分辨率数据集，识别出380多个面临气候变化和天气事件风险的沿海联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，总面积超过2.35亿公顷。

body.en: Whenever coastal engineer Robert Nicholls looks outside one of his home’s windows, he can see the Hurst Castle Spit on the south coast of England slowly eroding across the sea. “In a way, Hurst Castle is a part of me, because I did all my Ph.D. work on the spit.” ​Although this particular castle doesn’t have an international heritage status, it inspired Nicholls to study how climate change and weather events threaten the survival of such sites across the globe. Now, Nicholls has co-created the first global high-resolution digital dataset of UNESCO World Heritage Sites located along coastlines. Together, the included sites cover more than 235 million hectares (~581 million acres).​ ​Nicholls and his colleagues say the database can be used as a tool to help assess vulnerabilities of coastal sites that possess great natural and cultural significance, and local authorities can make them more resilient in the face of climate change and other threats posed by weather extremes. “The surprising thing, I suppose, was the number of sites in the coastal zone,” Nicholls, a professor of climate adaptation at the University of East Anglia, told Mongabay over a video call. The database, published in the journal Scientific Data in July, includes 386 locations and maps cultural landmarks; biocultural sites deemed to have both ecological and cultural value; and unique ecosystems, biodiversity fortresses and geological marvels. All are threatened by climate change and other environmental factors that might not be directly tied to it, such as erosion, according to co-author…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 每当海岸工程师罗伯特·尼科尔斯（Robert Nicholls）向自家窗户外望去时，他都能看到英格兰南海岸的赫斯特城堡沙嘴（Hurst Castle Spit）正在慢慢地被海水侵蚀。 “在某种程度上，赫斯特城堡是我的一部分，因为我所有的博士研究工作都是关于吐口水的。”尽管这座特殊的城堡没有获得国际遗产地位，但它激发了尼科尔斯研究气候变化和天气事件如何威胁全球此类遗址的生存。现在，尼科尔斯共同创建了第一个关于位于海岸线的联合国教科文组织世界遗产的全球高分辨率数字数据集。所包括的地点总共覆盖超过 2.35 亿公顷（约 5.81 亿英亩）。Nicholls 和他的同事表示，该数据库可以用作帮助评估具有重大自然和文化意义的沿海地点脆弱性的工具，地方当局可以使它们在面对气候变化和极端天气造成的其他威胁时更具弹性。 “我认为令人惊讶的是沿海地区的站点数量，”东安格利亚大学气候适应教授尼科尔斯在视频通话中告诉 Mongabay。该数据库于 7 月发表在《科学数据》杂志上，包含 386 个地点和文化地标地图；被认为具有生态和文化价值的生物文化遗址；以及独特的生态系统、生物多样性堡垒和地质奇观。据合著者称，所有这些都受到气候变化和其他可能与其没有直接关系的环境因素（例如侵蚀）的威胁……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The diligent work of coastal engineer Robert Nicholls to map climate risks to over 380 coastal World Heritage Sites reminds us of humanity's ongoing call to care for creation. Just as Yahweh God placed the first humans in a garden to "work it and keep it," we are entrusted with the stewardship of our planet's natural and cultural treasures. This global...
reflection.zh: 沿海工程师罗伯特·尼科尔斯勤勉地绘制380多个沿海世界遗产地气候风险的工作，提醒我们人类持续受召看护受造物。正如雅伟神将最初的人类安置在伊甸园中“耕种看守”，我们也受托管理地球的自然和文化宝藏。这份全球数据集代表着一项深思熟虑的努力，旨在理解并保护这些脆弱之地免受气候变化的影响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: El Niño climate patterns supercharged by burning of fossil fuels, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现，厄尔尼诺气候模式因化石燃料燃烧而加剧

summary.en: A new study reveals that strong El Niño climate patterns, including a 'Godzilla' event currently developing, have been intensified by the planet's overheating due to fossil fuel burning. This could lead to 50 million people facing acute hunger by the end of next year.
summary.zh: 一项新研究发现，包括目前正在形成的“哥斯拉”事件在内，近几十年来强烈的厄尔尼诺气候模式因化石燃料燃烧导致地球过热而加剧。这可能导致到明年年底，有5000万人面临严重饥饿。

body.en: ‘Godzilla’ event currently brewing could push 50 million people into acute hunger before the end of next year A series of strong El Niño climatic patterns in recent decades, such as the “Godzilla” event currently brewing that is set to warp weather around the world, have been supercharged by the broader overheating of the planet caused by the burning of fossil fuels, a major new study has found. El Niño is a naturally occurring phenomenon, taking place every two to seven years, when the waters of the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean heat up, causing a cascade of impacts around the world. The latest developing El Niño, set to peak later this year, is set to be the strongest in living memory and has been informally dubbed a “Godzilla” event. Continue reading...
body.zh: 目前正在酝酿的“哥斯拉”事件可能会在明年底前让 5000 万人陷入严重饥饿。一项重大的新研究发现，近几十年来一系列强烈的厄尔尼诺气候模式，例如目前正在酝酿的“哥斯拉”事件，将导致世界各地的天气发生变化，而化石燃料燃烧导致的地球更广泛的过热加剧了这一现象。厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然发生的现象，每两到七年发生一次，当东热带太平洋海水升温时，会对世界各地造成一系列影响。最新发展的厄尔尼诺现象将于今年晚些时候达到顶峰，这将是人们记忆中最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，被非正式地称为“哥斯拉”事件。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that a 'Godzilla' El Niño, intensified by human actions, could push 50 million people into acute hunger is a stark reminder of our interconnectedness and responsibility. Yahweh's word calls us to share our bread with the hungry and not hide from the needs of our own flesh. As global weather patterns warp, the urgency to care for those most...
reflection.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象因人类活动而加剧，可能导致5000万人面临严重饥饿，这提醒我们彼此相连的责任。雅伟的话语呼召我们与饥饿的人分享食物，不要对我们骨肉的需要视而不见。随着全球气候模式的扭曲，关怀那些最易受饥荒影响的人变得日益紧迫。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: The Guardian view on the Nepal-Tibet floods: prepare for more climate-linked disasters | Editorial
title.zh: 卫报视点：尼泊尔-西藏洪水：为更多气候相关的灾难做好准备

summary.en: Thousands of people in Nepal and Tibet are in desperate need of emergency assistance following a devastating flash flood likely linked to glacier collapse. With 360 people confirmed dead and more than 1,300 still missing, search and rescue operations are struggling against the aftermath of a brown torrent that swept...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏，数千人在一场可能与冰川坍塌有关的毁灭性山洪后急需紧急援助。目前已确认360人死亡，1300多人失踪，搜救行动正在全力应对席卷一切的褐色洪流所造成的破坏。

body.en: Medicine, food and other supplies are the urgent priority. But the rising risks from shrinking glaciers must be faced too Thousands of people in Nepal and Tibet are in desperate need of emergency assistance following Wednesday’s disaster. With 360 people confirmed dead, more than 1,300 others are still missing as search and rescue operations continue. The precise sequence of events linking glacier collapse to flash floods is yet to be confirmed. But there is no doubting the enormous destructive power of the brown torrent that can be seen on video clips surging down the steeply sided Himalayan valleys, sweeping away everyone and everything in its path. Testimony from survivors about terrifying near-escapes and losses is reminiscent of previous disasters, including the 2004 tsunami. With some of the worst-affected areas still cut off and accessible only by helicopter, there is a high level of uncertainty about the total number of people who have died or homes that have been destroyed. Existing medical, food, shelter and sanitation supplies will need to be replenished. Pledges of help for locally led relief efforts from foreign governments and agencies, following reports that hundreds of those missing were tourists or pilgrims, must lead to swift action. People need basics including electricity and clean water before they can start to rebuild and recover. Continue reading...
body.zh: 药品、食品和其他物资是当务之急。但冰川萎缩带来的日益增加的风险也必须面对。周三的灾难发生后，尼泊尔和西藏的数千人迫切需要紧急援助。截至目前，已确认 360 人死亡，仍有 1,300 多人失踪，搜救行动仍在继续。将冰川崩塌与山洪爆发联系起来的确切事件顺序尚未得到证实。但毫无疑问，棕色洪流的巨大破坏力可以从视频片段中看到，它沿着陡峭的喜马拉雅山谷汹涌而下，席卷了沿途的所有人和一切。幸存者关于可怕的险些逃脱和损失的证词让人想起以前的灾难，包括 2004 年的海啸。由于一些受灾最严重的地区仍然与外界隔绝，只能通过直升机进入，因此死亡人数或房屋被毁坏的总数存在很大的不确定性。现有的医疗、食品、住所和卫生用品需要补充。在有报道称数百名失踪者是游客或朝圣者之后，外国政府和机构承诺为当地领导的救援工作提供帮助，必须迅速采取行动。人们在开始重建和恢复之前需要电力和清洁水等基本设施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The terrifying power of the brown torrent sweeping through the Himalayan valleys serves as a sobering reminder of human vulnerability in the face of environmental collapse. As we pray for the 1,300 people still missing, we are called to be a 'very present help' through practical aid and long-term stewardship of the glaciers. True refuge is found when we...
reflection.zh: 席卷喜马拉雅山谷的褐色洪流具有可怕的破坏力，这冷静地提醒我们在环境崩溃面前人类是多么脆弱。当我们为1300名失踪者祈祷时，雅伟感召我们通过实际援助和对冰川的长期治理，成为受难者“随时的帮助”。真正的避难所不仅在于属灵的安慰，更在于我们将对受苦者的即时怜悯与面对气候风险的勇气结合起来。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: ‘Devastating’ rush for critical minerals has little to do with green energy: Report
title.zh: 报告称，“毁灭性”的稀有矿产争夺战与绿色能源关系不大

summary.en: A new report published by U.S.-based think tank the Oakland Institute warns that the rush for critical minerals comes with massive implications for the world, especially African countries. The report, “RUSH: Global Scramble for Minerals Wages War on People and Planet,” challenges the popular narrative that an...
summary.zh: 美国智库奥克兰研究所发布的一份新报告警告称，对稀有矿产的争夺对全球，特别是非洲国家，带来了巨大影响。这份名为《争夺：全球矿产争夺战对人类和地球发动战争》的报告，挑战了矿业扩张对全球绿色能源转型至关重要的普遍说法。

body.en: A new report published by U.S.-based think tank the Oakland Institute warns that the rush for critical minerals comes with massive implications for the world, especially African countries. The report, “RUSH: Global Scramble for Minerals Wages War on People and Planet,” challenges the popular narrative that an expansion of mining operations is necessary for the global green energy transition. “The intensification of mineral extraction has already had devastating consequences around the world, destroying land, livelihoods, and waters,” Oakland Institute policy director Frederic Mousseau told Mongabay in an email. He added the projected expansion of mining to meet global mineral demands will only perpetuate this devastation. Global demand for critical minerals is projected to increase drastically over the next two to three decades. Between 2000 and 2024, nickel production rose by 187%, rare earth extraction by 329%, and lithium production by 1,602%. According to projections by the International Energy Agency, demand for six key minerals — copper, graphite, lithium, cobalt, rare earth elements, and nickel — will further skyrocket in the coming decades. The IEA forecasts that total mineral demand from clean energy technologies will at least double by 2040. However, the Oakland Institute report found that currently, most of the critical minerals produced end up in industries unrelated to the green energy transition. Solar, wind, battery storage, and power networks for renewables together make up around a fifth of the demand, while defense and aerospace, conventional transport, AI data centers, and construction account for the rest. In Africa, home to…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 美国智库奥克兰研究所发布的一份新报告警告说，对关键矿产的抢购对世界，尤其是非洲国家产生了巨大影响。这份题为《RUSH：全球矿产争夺战对人类和地球造成的战争》的报告挑战了一种流行的说法，即扩大采矿作业对于全球绿色能源转型是必要的。奥克兰研究所政策主任 Frederic Mousseau 在一封电子邮件中告诉 Mongabay：“矿产开采的集约化已经在世界各地造成了毁灭性后果，破坏了土地、生计和水域。”他补充说，为满足全球矿产需求而预计的采矿扩张只会使这种破坏永久化。预计未来两到三十年全球对关键矿物的需求将大幅增加。 2000年至2024年间，镍产量增长了187%，稀土开采量增长了329%，锂产量增长了1,602%。根据国际能源署的预测，未来几十年对铜、石墨、锂、钴、稀土元素和镍六种主要矿物的需求将进一步飙升。 IEA 预测，到 2040 年，清洁能源技术对矿物的总需求将至少增加一倍。然而，奥克兰研究所的报告发现，目前生产的大多数关键矿物最终都流向与绿色能源转型无关的行业。太阳能、风能、电池存储和可再生能源电力网络合计约占需求的五分之一，而国防和航空航天、传统运输、人工智能数据中心和建筑则占其余需求。在非洲，......本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Oakland Institute's report highlights the devastating consequences of the global rush for critical minerals, particularly in African countries, challenging the idea that all such expansion is truly beneficial for green energy. While many actions may seem permissible or even necessary, Yahweh's wisdom reminds us that not everything that is "lawful" is...
reflection.zh: 奥克兰研究所的报告揭示了全球稀有矿产争夺战，尤其是在非洲国家，所造成的毁灭性后果，挑战了所有此类扩张都真正有益于绿色能源的观点。虽然许多行动看似可行甚至必要，但雅伟的智慧提醒我们，并非所有“合法”的事情最终都对人类和受造物有益或具建设性。这呼吁我们审慎辨别我们所追求事物的真实影响，确保我们为进步所做的努力不会无意中伤害我们旨在帮助的人民和地球。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: A Hard-Won Rule to Cut Chemical Plant Pollution Is Being Unraveled
title.zh: 一项来之不易的削减化工厂污染的法规正在被废除

summary.en: In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.
summary.zh: 2024年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，以保护石化厂附近的社区免受有毒空气的侵害。此后，特朗普政府已向数十家污染设施授予豁免权，并正在着手修改这项期待已久的法规。

body.en:
In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.

In April 2024, Tish Taylor and her father, Robert, stood behind President Joe Biden’s Environmental Protection Agency chief, Michael Regan, as he signed a regulation designed to dramatically reduce toxic pollution from petrochemical plants like those that cluster near the Taylors’ homes along the lower Mississippi River, in Louisiana.

Taylor struggled not to cry through the signing ceremony, which followed years of demands from communities like hers — in the 85-mile corridor between New Orleans and Baton Rouge that has become known as Cancer Alley — for tighter limits on plants’ emissions. The new regulation, known as the HON rule, was “a wonderful gift to generations ahead of us,” Taylor said. “It’s hard for me to find the words to say how validated we felt.”

For decades, regulations on emissions of hazardous chemicals such as toluene, ethylene oxide, and vinyl chloride have been weaker than restrictions on more common pollutants, such as those emitted by vehicles.

The Biden administration took major steps to strengthen Clean Air Act rules on those hazardous air pollutants, and the HON rule was a centerpiece of that effort. Toughening requirements on six different pollutants at more than 200 petrochemical plants , it was one of a slate of regulations the Biden administration enacted on air toxics, each covering a specific industry, from steelmaking to tire manufacturing.

But shortly after President Donald Trump began his second term, his administration began unraveling those rules, including the one the Taylors had so recently celebrated. Last year, Trump granted two-year exemptions from the HON rule to more than 50 petrochemical facilities. This July, he issued 20 more temporary exemptions, and the EPA said it would propose a rewrite of the regulation this fall. The new version is all but certain to significantly scale back the rule’s protections.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“Everything that the Biden administration did to help protect us was pretty much just thrown in the garbage,” Tish Taylor said in July, and replaced by “a death sentence.” St. John the Baptist Parish, where her family lives, has the country’s highest risk of cancer from air pollution — nearly 50 times the national average. A disproportionate percentage of those exposed to the highest levels of pollution in the region are Black.

A set of amendments to several existing regulations on toxic air pollutants, the HON rule — which stands for Hazardous...
body.zh: 2024 年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，保护石化厂附近的社区免受空气有毒物质的影响。此后，特朗普政府已对数十家污染设施给予豁免，并正在努力重写这项期待已久的规则。 2024 年 4 月，蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲罗伯特支持乔·拜登总统的环境保护局局长迈克尔·里根签署了一项法规，旨在大幅减少石化厂（例如路易斯安那州密西西比河下游泰勒家附近聚集的石化厂）的有毒污染。 泰勒在签字仪式上努力不哭，多年来，像她这样的社区——位于新奥尔良和巴吞鲁日之间的 85 英里走廊，被称为“癌症巷”——要求更严格地限制植物排放。泰勒说，这项被称为 HON 规则的新规定是“给我们前几代人的一份美妙礼物”。 “我很难找到合适的词来表达我们的感受。” 几十年来，对甲苯、环氧乙烷和氯乙烯等危险化学品排放的法规一直弱于对车辆排放等更常见污染物的限制。 拜登政府采取了重大措施，加强《清洁空气法》对这些有害空气污染物的规定，而 HON 规定是这一努力的核心。这是拜登政府针对空气有毒物质颁布的一系列法规之一，对 200 多家石化厂的六种不同污染物提出了严格要求，每项法规都涵盖从炼钢到轮胎制造等特定行业。 但在唐纳德·特朗普总统开始第二个任期后不久，他的政府开始解开这些规则，包括泰勒家族最近庆祝的规则。去年，特朗普向 50 多家石化设施授予两年 HON 规则豁免。今年 7 月，他又发布了 20 项临时豁免，美国环保署表示将在今年秋天提议重写该法规。新版本几乎肯定会大幅缩减该规则的保护范围。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 蒂什·泰勒 (Tish Taylor) 在 7 月表示：“拜登政府为保护我们所做的一切几乎都被扔进了垃圾堆，取而代之的是“死刑”。她家人居住的施洗者圣约翰教区因空气污染而患癌症的风险是全国最高的——几乎是全国平均水平的 50 倍。在该地区暴露于最高污染水平的人群中，黑人所占比例过高。 HON 规则是对多项有关有毒空气污染物的现行法规的一系列修正案，它代表危险……

reflection.en: The story of Tish Taylor and her father, who stood by as a vital regulation was signed to protect communities from toxic air, highlights the constant need for leaders to uphold justice. Yahweh's word in Jeremiah 22:3 calls those in authority to "do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed." When hard-won...
reflection.zh: 蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲见证了一项旨在保护社区免受有毒空气侵害的重要法规的签署，这个故事凸显了领导者维护正义的持续必要性。雅伟在耶利米书22:3中的话语呼吁掌权者“施行公平和公义，从欺压者手中拯救被抢夺的”。当像密西西比河下游沿岸社区这样脆弱的群体，他们来之不易的保护措施受到威胁时，这提醒我们，在灵性和人性上，都需要有公义的治理来保障所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Country diary: A stonking great harmful hornet? Ah it’s only a fly | Paul Evans
title.zh: 乡村日记：一只巨大的有害大黄蜂？啊，它只是一只苍蝇 | 保罗·埃文斯

summary.en: The Marches, Shropshire: For this hoverfly, pretending to be far more dangerous than it actually is has been a useful evolutionary technique.
summary.zh: 什罗普郡马奇斯：对于这种食蚜蝇来说，假装比实际更危险是一种有用的进化策略。

body.en: The Marches, Shropshire : For this hoverfly, pretending to be far more dangerous than it actually is has been a useful evolutionary technique Back in the analogue world – where “analogue” means signals transmitted by continuous waves of sound or light, but also means something that looks like something else – intelligence is more poetic and weirder than its shambling digital doppelganger. In a bend of the heatwave, a remarkable fly lands on a rose leaf in full sun. The hornet mimic hoverfly , Volucella zonaria , is a stonking great (for a hoverfly) 2cm-long creature with a peachy-yellow and black striped abdomen. It has no sting, a chestnut thorax and a big-eyed head with a pad for nectar, not jaws for chomping insects, two rather than four cellophane wings folded at rest, and an aura to unnerve the uninitiated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 什罗普郡马尔凯：对于这种食蚜蝇来说，假装比实际危险得多是一种有用的进化技术。回到模拟世界——“模拟”意味着通过连续的声波或光波传输的信号，但也意味着看起来像其他东西的东西——智慧比它蹒跚的数字分身更具诗意和怪异。在热浪的拐角处，一只引人注目的苍蝇落在阳光充足的玫瑰叶上。拟黄蜂食蚜蝇 (Volucella zonaria) 是一种巨大的生物（对于食蚜蝇而言），体长 2 厘米，腹部呈桃黄色和黑色条纹。它没有刺，有栗色的胸部，有一个大眼睛的头，上面有一个用来吸食花蜜的垫子，没有用来咀嚼昆虫的下巴，休息时折叠着两个而不是四个玻璃纸翅膀，还有一种让外行人感到不安的光环。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The hornet mimic hoverfly in Shropshire, with its clever disguise, reminds us of the intricate and often surprising wisdom embedded in the natural world. Just as the article marvels at this "useful evolutionary technique," Yahweh's creation continually invites us to observe and learn from its wonders. The natural world, from the smallest insect to the...
reflection.zh: 什罗普郡的这种模仿大黄蜂的食蚜蝇，以其巧妙的伪装，提醒我们自然界中蕴含着精妙而常常令人惊叹的智慧。正如文章惊叹于这种“有用的进化策略”一样，雅伟的创造不断邀请我们观察并学习其奇妙之处。从最小的昆虫到最宏伟的景观，自然界都在述说着造物主的匠心。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Birds have an eerie association with death | Letter
title.zh: 鸟与死亡的诡异关联 | 信件

summary.en: Responding to a story about birds comforting someone during bereavement, a letter writer shares her own experience of a wren flying into her classroom and being found dead on the day her mother-in-law died, contrasting with another friend's belief that birds contacting them were spirits of the deceased.
summary.zh: 一位读者在回应一篇关于鸟类在丧亲之痛中安慰人们的文章时，分享了她自己的经历：在她婆婆去世的那天，一只鹪鹩飞进了她的教室，并在地上被发现死亡。这与另一位朋友的经历形成对比，那位朋友认为接触她的鸟是已故亲人的灵魂。

body.en: Responding to an article in which birds comforted Helen Harris during bereavement, Angela Smith describes her own experience Helen Harris’s experience ( A moment that changed me: my husband died – and birds began behaving strangely towards me, 19 August ) chimes with that of a friend of mine who had many close encounters with robins after the death of her father. She too had birds flying into her house as never before but, unlike Helen, she believed that this was the person’s spirit making contact. My own association between birds and death is rather different. The day my mother-in-law died, a wren had flown into the window of the classroom where I taught, and I found it dead on the ground outside. When we took her ashes to be scattered in the sea, a pheasant hit the car windscreen and died. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安吉拉·史密斯在回应一篇关于鸟儿在海伦·哈里斯丧亲之痛时安慰她的文章时，描述了她自己的经历。海伦·哈里斯的经历（改变我的时刻：我的丈夫死了——鸟儿开始对我表现得很奇怪，8 月 19 日）与我的一个朋友的经历不谋而合，她在父亲去世后与知更鸟有过多次亲密接触。她也有鸟儿前所未有地飞进她的房子，但与海伦不同的是，她相信这是人的灵魂在接触。我自己对鸟类与死亡的联系则相当不同。我婆婆去世的那天，一只鹪鹩飞进了我任教的教室的窗户，我发现它死在外面的地上。当我们把她的骨灰撒到海里时，一只野鸡撞到了汽车挡风玻璃死了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The writer shares a somber coincidence: a wren found dead in her classroom on the same day her mother-in-law passed away. This personal observation, alongside another's belief in spiritual contact through birds, touches on the deep mysteries of life, death, and the natural world. The Psalmist marvels at the intricate wisdom woven into creation, reminding us...
reflection.zh: 作者分享了一个令人伤感的巧合：在她婆婆去世的同一天，一只鹪鹩在她教室里被发现死亡。这个个人观察，以及另一位朋友相信鸟类是逝者的灵魂的说法，触及了生命、死亡和自然界的深层奥秘。诗人惊叹于雅伟创造中编织的精妙智慧，提醒我们即使在悲伤中，祂浩瀚的作为也环绕着我们。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Access to Urban Woodlands Linked With Lower Use of Antidepressants
title.zh: 城市林地可达性与抗抑郁药使用量降低相关

summary.en: A study conducted in Scotland found a significant correlation between living near accessible urban woodlands and a reduced likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants. The research focused on the impact of the 'Woods In and Around Towns' program, which has revitalized nearly 30,000 acres of urban woodlands since...
summary.zh: 一项在苏格兰进行的研究发现，居住在可达的城市林地附近与服用抗抑郁药的可能性显著降低之间存在关联。这项研究关注了“城镇及周边林地计划”的影响，该计划自2005年以来已复兴了近3万英亩的城市林地。

body.en:
A study from Scotland found that living near an accessible urban woodland significantly lowered the likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants.

The research focused on Scotland’s Woods In and Around Towns program , which aims to plant, restore, or protect woodlands in deprived neighborhoods and make them accessible to the public by installing signs, trails, and walking paths. Launched in 2005, the WIAT program has revitalized nearly 30,000 acres of urban woodlands.

From the beginning, one of the central aims of the program has been to improve mental health. To gauge its success, researchers at the Universities of Edinburgh and Glasgow tracked more than 129,000 people across Scotland over five years. They found that when people moved to within a 10-minute walk of a WIAT woodland, their odds of being prescribed an antidepressant dropped by 10 percent, while their odds of being prescribed anti-anxiety medication dropped by 6 percent.

“Our results tell us that relatively modest investments in local green spaces can make a real difference to people’s mental health,” said lead author Scott Ogletree of the University of Edinburgh. The findings were published in The Lancet Planetary Health .

A host of prior studies have found that living near green spaces can reduce stress , improve moods , and lower the risk of developing anxiety or depression. Some research has even found that exposure to nature can help reduce violent crime. In light of the well-documented benefits of living near green spaces, the World Health Organization recommends urban planners establish at least 1 acre of green space within 1,000 feet of every home.
body.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可到达的城市林地附近会显着降低服用抗抑郁药物的可能性。 该研究重点关注苏格兰城镇内及周边的森林计划，该计划旨在种植、恢复或保护贫困社区的林地，并通过安装标志、小径和步行道使公众能够进入这些林地。 WIAT 计划于 2005 年启动，已振兴了近 30,000 英亩的城市林地。 从一开始，该计划的中心目标之一就是改善心理健康。为了衡量其成功程度，爱丁堡大学和格拉斯哥大学的研究人员在五年内对苏格兰各地超过 129,000 人进行了追踪。他们发现，当人们搬到距离 WIAT 林地 10 分钟步行路程的地方时，他们服用抗抑郁药物的几率会下降 10%，而服用抗焦虑药物的几率会下降 6%。 “我们的结果告诉我们，对当地绿地的相对适度的投资可以对人们的心理健康产生真正的影响，”爱丁堡大学的主要作者斯科特·奥格特里说。研究结果发表在《柳叶刀行星健康》上。 先前的大量研究发现，居住在绿色空间附近可以减轻压力，改善情绪，并降低患焦虑或抑郁的风险。一些研究甚至发现，接触大自然有助于减少暴力犯罪。鉴于居住在绿色空间附近的好处已得到充分证明，世界卫生组织建议城市规划者在每个家庭 1,000 英尺范围内至少建立 1 英亩的绿色空间。

reflection.en: The Scottish study highlights a profound truth: creation often offers solace and healing for the human spirit. As people gained access to nearly 30,000 acres of revitalized urban woodlands, researchers observed a lower likelihood of antidepressant prescriptions. This reminds us that Yahweh, who heals the brokenhearted, often uses the beauty and tranquility...
reflection.zh: 这项苏格兰研究揭示了一个深刻的真理：受造界常能为人的心灵带来慰藉与医治。随着人们得以进入近3万英亩经过复兴的城市林地，研究人员观察到服用抗抑郁药的可能性降低了。这提醒我们，雅伟医治伤心的人，祂常借着大自然的美丽与宁静来滋养我们内在的福祉。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Bomb Fishing Is Wreaking Havoc on Indonesia's Coral Reefs
title.zh: 炸弹捕鱼正在摧毁印度尼西亚的珊瑚礁

summary.en: Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”
summary.zh: 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸作业的渔民每年引爆超过8,000枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Inside Climate News and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”

Nicknamed the “Amazon of the Seas,” the Coral Triangle is the world’s most biologically diverse marine ecosystem. Sink below the surface and you’ll encounter the sound of a vibrant symphony of snapping shrimp, crunching crustaceans, and feeding fish.

But then the rhythmic music of life will dissolve into eerie silence, punctured only by the plosive boom of detonating bombs.

Off the coast of Indonesia’s Spermonde Archipelago, underwater microphones captured over 3,500 explosions in just 3,600 hours of recording, according to researchers from the Zoological Society of London.

The source? Blast fishing — a globally banned technique that uses plastic bottles packed with explosives to stun and kill everything in a 90-foot radius. The highly destructive practice has been documented in at least 34 countries, from Lebanon and Libya to Brazil and Ecuador.

While fishers predominantly use the method to catch fish for sale at local markets — identifiable by their ruptured internal organs and burst swim bladders — it’s also a grave threat to colorful coral reef habitats.

“Bomb fishing is quite likely the leading cause of reef loss in this area,” said Ben Williams, the paper’s lead author, noting that a single bomb can wreak 200 square feet of destruction. “These picturesque reefs get converted into a landscape that looks like the moon. It’s just rubble and dead coral with very little sign of life.”

In 2023, researchers from Britain and Indonesia snorkeled down and anchored $150 audio recorders to short stakes in the seafloor. Using A.I. software — which the team has now made open-source — they scoured 16 months of audio in just a few hours to identify possible detonations.

While the A.I. filtered suspected cases, each suggested sound wave was then manually verified to assess if it stemmed from a bomb or a misfiring boat engine.

With sound traveling over four times faster through water than air, the team of marine scientists were able to detect detonations from over 10 miles away.

“When [the bombs] are close, it’s so loud that it can shake you out of your skin,” said Williams. “But if you put your head up on the surface, you probably can’t even see the boat that did it.”

Accounting for stormy-season setbacks and spearfishermen who tampered with the recorders, the team calculated that there were likely more than 8,500 blasts each year — all within an area of just 350 square miles.

body.zh: 本文最初由《内部气候新闻》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛海岸作业的渔民每年会引爆 8,000 多枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。 珊瑚三角区被誉为“海洋亚马逊”，是世界上生物多样性最丰富的海洋生态系统。沉入水面以下，您会听到虾虾、甲壳类动物咀嚼和鱼儿喂食的充满活力的交响乐声。 但随后，生命的节奏音乐将消失在令人毛骨悚然的寂静中，只有炸弹爆炸的爆炸声刺破这一切。 据伦敦动物学会的研究人员称，在印度尼西亚斯佩蒙德群岛海岸附近，水下麦克风在短短 3,600 小时的记录中捕捉到了 3,500 多次爆炸。 来源？爆破捕鱼——一种全球禁止的技术，使用装有炸药的塑料瓶来击晕并杀死 90 英尺半径内的所有物体。从黎巴嫩、利比亚到巴西和厄瓜多尔，至少有 34 个国家记录了这种极具破坏性的做法。 虽然渔民主要使用这种方法捕捞鱼类并在当地市场出售（可以通过内脏破裂和鱼鳔破裂来识别），但它也对色彩缤纷的珊瑚礁栖息地构成严重威胁。 该论文的主要作者本·威廉姆斯 (Ben Williams) 表示：“炸弹捕鱼很可能是该地区珊瑚礁消失的主要原因。”他指出，一枚炸弹就可以造成 200 平方英尺的破坏。 “这些风景如画的珊瑚礁变成了看起来像月亮的景观。它只是碎石和死珊瑚，几乎没有生命迹象。” 2023 年，来自英国和印度尼西亚的研究人员潜入海底，将价值 150 美元的录音机固定在海底的短木桩上。使用人工智能该团队现已将软件开源，他们在短短几个小时内搜索了 16 个月的音频，以识别可能的爆炸。 虽然 A.I.过滤掉可疑病例后，每个建议的声波都会被手动验证，以评估它是否源于炸弹或失火的船发动机。 由于声音在水中传播的速度比空气中传播的速度快四倍多，海洋科学家团队能够探测到 10 英里外的爆炸。 “当[炸弹]靠近时，声音非常大，可以把你震得浑身不舒服，”威廉姆斯说。 “但如果你把头伸出水面，你可能甚至看不到那艘船。” 考虑到暴风雨季节的挫折和鱼叉渔民篡改记录仪的情况，该团队计算出每年可能发生超过 8,500 次爆炸——所有爆炸都发生在仅 350 平方英里的区域内。 每 62 分钟投下一颗炸弹，...

reflection.en: The tragic destruction of Indonesia's coral reefs by bomb fishing, with over 8,000 explosives detonated annually, serves as a stark reminder of how the pursuit of immediate wealth can devastate creation. Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can lead to all kinds of evil, and here we see it turning vibrant ecosystems like the "Amazon of the Seas" into...
reflection.zh: 印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸的炸弹捕鱼每年引爆超过8,000枚炸药，将珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”，这悲剧性地提醒我们，对眼前财富的追求如何能摧毁受造物。雅伟的话语警告说，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它将“海洋亚马逊”这样充满活力的生态系统变为一片废墟和“诡异的寂静”。这种做法不仅伤害环境，最终也损害了依赖这些宝贵资源的社区的长期福祉。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ‘Possible Love’ Trailer: ‘Burning’ Director Lee Chang-dong Returns with a Story of Documentary Filmmaking Gone Awry
title.zh: 《可能的爱》预告片：《燃烧》导演李沧东携纪录片失控故事回归

summary.en: Netflix is set to release "Possible Love," a new film from acclaimed director Lee Chang-dong, in theaters on Friday, October 23, following its Venice premiere. The film is described as a story of documentary filmmaking gone awry, continuing the director's tradition of capturing human despair.
summary.zh: 备受赞誉的导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》将于10月23日星期五在威尼斯首映后在影院上映。这部电影被描述为一个纪录片制作失控的故事，延续了导演捕捉人类绝望的传统。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

A new film from Lee Chang-dong is always a major event on the cinema calendar . The South Korean auteur has directed six movies since 1997, each one demonstrating his literary sensibilities and keen eye for capturing human despair. And ever since his seventh film, the upcoming “ Possible Love ,” was announced, cinephiles have been preparing to have their hearts broken.

“Possible Love” is loosely based on a segment of Krzysztof Kieślowski’s “Dekalog,” making it the second film of 2026 to take inspiration from the ten-part film that explored modern interpretations of the Ten Commandments. (The first was Asghar Farhadi’s “Parallel Lives,” which premiered to Cannes to mixed reviews.) The film explores the secrets hidden beneath marriages, following two married couples whose lives intersect while filming a documentary together. Related Stories Indie Films Should Tour Like a Band ‘Idiots’ Review: Macon Blair Merges ‘The Last Detail’ with ‘Road Trip’ in a Wildly Uneven Comedy That Fails to Find Its Own Lane

“Possible Love” stars Jeon Do-yeon, Sul Kyung-gu, Zo In-sung, and Cho Yeo-jeong. Lee co-wrote the film with Oh Jung-mi.

An official synopsis for the film reads: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

“Possible Love” will have its world premiere at the 2026 Venice International Film Festival , where it will compete for the Golden Lion. It will go on to screen at the Toronto International Film Festival before Netflix releases it domestically in October. The film has been selected as South Korea’s official submission to the Best International Feature category at the 99th Academy Awards.

While Lee has not released a film in eight years, he has remained active in the world of literature and continued to promote repertory screenings of his work. In a 2024 interview with IndieWire , he reflected on the thematic threads connecting his entire filmography.

“Everyone unexpectedly faces pain and suffers from hopelessness and failure,” Lee said. “That is life. The world unjustly suppresses and gives pain to an individual. The problem is how you cope with the pain. Thus, the struggle is more important than the pain itself. Through the struggle, humans find the purpose of life and find salvation. Protagonists in tragedies are those types of people. I tried to...
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 李沧东的新片永远是电影日历上的一件大事。这位韩国导演自 1997 年以来执导了六部电影，每一部电影都展示了他的文学敏感性和捕捉人类绝望的敏锐眼光。自从他的第七部电影即将上映的《可能的爱》宣布以来，影迷们就已经做好了心碎的准备。 《可能的爱》大致改编自克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《十诫》中的一个片段，这使其成为 2026 年第二部从这部探讨十诫现代诠释的十集电影中汲取灵感的电影。 （第一部是阿斯加尔·法哈迪的《平行生活》，该片在戛纳首映，评价褒贬不一。）这部电影探讨了隐藏在婚姻之下的秘密，讲述了两对已婚夫妇在一起拍摄纪录片时生活交叉的故事。相关故事独立电影应该像乐队一样巡回演出《白痴》评论：梅肯·布莱尔将《最后的细节》与《公路旅行》融合在一部极其不平衡的喜剧中，但未能找到自己的道路 《可能的爱情》由全度妍、薛景求、赵寅成、曹汝贞主演。李与吴正美共同编剧了这部电影。 影片的官方剧情简介如下：一名下岗工人和他的妻子与一名纪录片制片人和她的配偶相遇，并面对他们隐藏的欲望。 《可能的爱情》将在2026年威尼斯国际电影节全球首映，角逐金狮奖。该片将在多伦多国际电影节上放映，然后 Netflix 将于 10 月份在国内上映。该片已被选为韩国正式提交的第 99 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳国际影片奖。 尽管李已经八年没有发行电影了，但他仍然活跃在文学界，并继续推动其作品的剧目放映。在 2024 年接受 IndieWire 采访时，他反思了连接他整个电影作品的主题线索。 “每个人都会意外地面临痛苦、绝望和失败，”李说。 “这就是生活。这个世界不公正地压制和给予一个人痛苦。问题是你如何应对痛苦。因此，斗争比痛苦本身更重要。通过斗争，人类找到了生活的目的，找到了救赎。悲剧的主角就是这样的人。我试图……

reflection.en: Director Lee Chang-dong's new film, "Possible Love," promises to delve into "human despair" and leave audiences "brokenhearted" as it explores documentary filmmaking gone awry. In a world where stories often highlight profound suffering, Psalm 34:18 reminds us that Yahweh is near to those who are brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit. This offers a...
reflection.zh: 导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》承诺将深入探讨“人类的绝望”，并随着纪录片制作的失控而让观众“心碎”。在一个故事常常凸显深重苦难的世界里，诗篇34:18提醒我们，雅伟亲近伤心的人，拯救灵里破碎的人。这提供了一种安静的盼望，即使面对生命中最艰难的现实，神圣的同在也与那些受苦的人同在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

summary.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham...
summary.zh: 由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔（与巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔共同执导《无他之地》）执导的《卫报》制作的加沙纪录片，将调查战争期间“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”，并将在威尼斯电影节首映。这部名为《NAZA》的电影由吉姆·威尔逊制作，乔纳森·格雷泽（《利益区域》团队）担任执行制片人，是今...

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Hanging By a Wire review – cable car rescue documentary dangles viewers on the edge of disaster
title.zh: 《悬挂在钢丝上》影评——缆车救援纪录片让观众悬在灾难边缘

summary.en: The documentary "Hanging By a Wire" recounts the tense survival story of eight people trapped in a cable car above a chasm in Pakistan, featuring their extraordinary fate and daring rescue.
summary.zh: 纪录片《悬挂在钢丝上》讲述了八名被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方缆车中的人们惊心动魄的生存故事，展现了他们非凡的命运和大胆的救援行动。

body.en: The extraordinary fate of eight people trapped above a chasm in Pakistan makes for a tense, skilfully assembled survival story with unexpected flashes of comedy Survival documentaries are a weird little genre of nonfiction film-making that recount the stories of accidents and natural catastrophes – and more often than not, the daring rescues of people caught up in them. Eyewitnesses and the loved ones of those endangered are top of the interview list, to keep the sense of danger and emotional stakes at the top of everyone’s mind. Survivors can also have their say, and more adventurous film-makers might care to recreate the action with actors or the actual survivors themselves. This account of how eight people – six teenage boys and two adult men – were left suspended over a chasm in northern Pakistan in 2023, when a wire on the cable car they were travelling on broke, is a pretty conventional example of the form. For obvious reasons, no one tries to recreate the situation, but since it was quite recent there is no shortage of news footage and amateur clips to fill out the particulars. The downside of doing a story that’s so recent is that some of the audience may remember what happened anyway, but still there’s plenty of nail-nibbling suspense here, and sequences that will give anyone with acrophobia the heebie jeebies – especially the drone shots that zoom close on the terrified faces of those trapped inside the dangling car. body.zh: 八个人被困在巴基斯坦的深渊上，他们的非凡命运造就了一个紧张而巧妙的生存故事，其中有意想不到的喜剧闪现。生存纪录片是一种奇怪的非虚构电影制作类型，讲述了事故和自然灾害的故事，而且往往讲述了被困人员的勇敢营救。目击者和那些濒临灭绝的人的亲人是采访的首要对象，以便让每个人都牢记危险感和情感风险。幸存者也可以发表意见，更具冒险精神的电影制作人可能会愿意与演员或真正的幸存者本人一起重现动作。这个故事描述了 2023 年，八个人（六名十几岁的男孩和两名成年男子）在巴基斯坦北部的一个峡谷上悬吊着，当时他们乘坐的缆车上的电线断裂了，这是这种形式的一个非常传统的例子。出于显而易见的原因，没有人试图重现这种情况，但由于这是最近发生的事情，因此不乏新闻片段和业余剪辑来填充细节。制作一个最近发生的故事的缺点是，一些观众可能会记得发生了什么，但这里仍然有很多令人紧张的悬念，以及会让任何有恐高症的人感到惊慌的序列——尤其是无人机拍摄的镜头，近距离拍摄那些被困在悬空的汽车里的人惊恐的面孔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The harrowing ordeal of eight individuals suspended above a chasm in a Pakistani cable car reminds us of how vulnerable life can be when disaster strikes. In such moments of extreme peril, the human spirit yearns for a refuge and strength beyond its own, a help that is truly ever-present. Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble,...
reflection.zh: 八名乘客被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方的缆车中，这惊心动魄的经历提醒我们，当灾难降临时，生命是多么脆弱。在如此极度的危险时刻，人的心灵渴望超越自身的力量，寻求一个真正无处不在的避难所和力量。雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助，当面对压倒性的挑战时，祂赐予我们安慰和支持。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: ‘Boorman and the Devil’ Review: This Deep Dive Into How ‘Exorcist II: The Heretic’ Spiraled Out of Control Deserves a Wide Release
title.zh: 《布尔曼与魔鬼》评论：深入探讨《驱魔人 II：异端》如何失控，值得广泛发布

summary.en: David Kittredge conjures a true film lover's retrospective in this magical John Boorman documentary.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自纪录片栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

Editor’s note: This review was originally published on October 24, 2025 out of the 2025 Brooklyn Horror Film Festival. Yellow Veil Pictures will release the film at NYC’s Quad Cinema on Friday, August 28, with expansion to follow.

David Kittredge delivers a dazzling reflection on the career of John Boorman in the documentary “ Boorman and the Devil ,” a robust reframing of the legendary director’s “ Exorcist II: The Heretic ,” as strange and poetic as the disastrous 1977 production itself.

These days, Boorman’s much-maligned sequel to William Friedkin’s supernatural masterpiece is best known as a string of memes. You’ve got James Earl Jones dressed as a giant locust . Linda Blair tap-dancing her demons away . Even the film’s core concept of The Synchronizer, a baffling psychic invention from the script that not only vexed audiences but forced unionized crew members to debate whether the thing was a light or a prop. Related Stories ‘The Dog Stars’ Review: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin Can’t Save Ridley Scott’s Bizarrely Inert Post-Apocalypse Movie from Near-Disaster Dolly Parton, Iconic Singer/Songwriter and ‘9 to 5’ Star, Dies at 80

An embarrassment of riches for behind-the-scenes factoids, “Exorcist II: The Heretic” is a lot more than a punchline and as memorable as any real train wreck. If you already like the 1977 movie (and I’ll tell you right now, you should !), then “Boorman and the Devil” might not make the argument that it’s objectively good as fiercely as you’d like . But for those who hate “Exorcist II” or just haven’t seen it, Kittredge provides a sparkling on-ramp to New Hollywood history and Boorman’s astonishing career. (Note: The film also features IndieWire’s Jim Hemphill as a talking head.)

92 years old now, Boorman debuted in black-and-white with “Catch Us If You Can” (1965), before canoeing to the Oscars with Jon Voight in “Deliverance” (1972) and blasting off into batshit space with Sean Connery and a fur bikini for “Zardoz” (1974) . At the top of his game when he was offered the chance to direct the original “Exorcist” over Friedkin, the British cinephile declined, and embraced his own original and audacious visions instead. title.en: ‘NAZA’ Documentary from ‘No Other Land’ Directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor Sets North American Premiere at NYFF
title.zh: 《NAZA》纪录片——《无他之地》导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和瑞秋·索尔的作品，将在纽约电影节北美首映

summary.en: The documentary 'NAZA,' directed by Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, will have its North American premiere at the New York Film Festival after its world premiere in Venice. The film focuses on Israeli military operations in Gaza.
summary.zh: 由以色列电影制作人尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和瑞秋·索尔执导的纪录片《NAZA》将在威尼斯国际电影节进行世界首映后，于纽约电影节进行北美首映。该片聚焦于以色列在加沙的军事行动。

body.en:

Just when it seemed like the 2026 New York Film Festival lineup was complete, another major film has been added to the 64th edition.

“ NAZA ,” a new documentary about the war in Gaza from Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, will make its North American premiere at NYFF . The Lincoln Center screening will follow its world premiere at the Venice International Film Festival.

Abraham and Szor served as two of the four directors of the critically acclaimed (and inevitably controversial) 2024 documentary “No Other Land.” They shared directing duties with Palestinian filmmakers Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal. That Oscar-winning film was notable for its collaboration between Palestinian and Israeli artists and its unapologetic support for the Palestinian cause. Related Stories Ridley Scott Reveals Lost ‘Blade Runner’ Script Idea That Proved Too Complicated, and Why Harrison Ford ‘Didn’t Get’ the Movie ‘The Dog Stars’ Review: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin Can’t Save Ridley Scott’s Bizarrely Inert Post-Apocalypse Movie from Near-Disaster

While Abraham and Szor are working by themselves this time around, “NAZA” explores similar subject matter. Shot on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the new film takes a closer look at the practices of the Israeli Defense Forces, taking its title from a military term for the number of civilian casualties that are expected from a given operation.

“NAZA” is produced by The Guardian and James Wilson for JW Films. Jonathan Glazer also serves as an executive producer on the film. Wilson notably produced Glazer’s most recent film, “The Zone of Interest.”

“’NAZA’ is an important investigative documentary about one of the gravest catastrophes of our time. The film brings critical information to light and, through its singular cinematic language, prompts broader questions of individual and societal complicity and accountability, especially in a time of intersecting global conflicts and endless wars,” NYFF artistic director Dennis Lim said in a statement. “Like many films in this year’s NYFF slate, it demonstrates cinema’s enduring ability to reflect and engage with the world around us.”

reflection.en: The documentary 'NAZA' brings the realities of Israeli military operations in Gaza to the screen, prompting reflection on the enduring cycles of conflict. As we witness these events, the ancient call to 'not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21) resonates deeply, urging a path beyond retaliation towards healing and peace.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》将以色列在加沙的军事行动的现实呈现在银幕上，引人深思冲突的持久循环。当我们目睹这些事件时，那古老的呼唤“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶”（罗马书12:21）产生了深刻的共鸣，敦促我们超越报复，走向疗愈与和平。
